*Bo Wang,Ruixing Zhang,Yunqi Liu,Yang Zhang,Liangzhe Han,Tongyu Zhu,Leilei Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出UserIDA（User Intent-Directive Alignment），一种可控用户模拟器框架，将"下一用户轮次应实现何种局部交互意图"与"该意图如何用语言表达"分离，通过六类意图接口、指令条件生成和监督微调，结合基于意图校准的策略优化，显著提升模拟用户的意图准确率和回复质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户模拟器被广泛用于训练和评估交互式助手，但生成下一用户轮次本质上是"一对多"的：相同的档案和对话上下文可能支持多种不同的合理续接，且这些续接具有不同的局部交互意图（如接受而非修复）。一个流畅的回复可能通过不恰当的意图推进对话，导致模拟失真。因此，可控用户模拟的核心挑战在于需要对意图进行显式控制，而非仅关注语言流畅性。

Method: UserIDA的核心方法包括：(1) 将交互意图作为显式的每轮指令（per-turn directive）暴露出来，实现意图与语言表达的解耦；(2) 定义六类交互意图接口；(3) 通过监督微调学习指令条件化生成；(4) 在基于组的强化学习中使用意图校准的策略优化，其奖励函数在保留复合回复质量的同时，确保违反意图的候选在混合组中排名低于符合意图的候选。

Result: 在LMSYS-USP基准上，UserIDA达到86.6%的意图准确率，超过最强专用用户模拟器基线24.3个百分点，同时提升了语义和风格相似度。在上下文内干预测试中，UserIDA在91.7%的对话状态下能实现至少四种目标意图，而最强外部基线的该比例为22.9%。

Conclusion: 研究结果确立了每轮意图控制作为用户模拟中与回复保真度互补的重要维度的地位。将意图（做什么）与表达（怎么说）分离，并显式控制意图方向，能有效改善用户模拟器的实用性和可控性。

Abstract: User simulators are widely used as scalable environments for training and evaluating interactive assistants. Generating the next user turn is inherently one-to-many: the same profile and dialogue context may support multiple plausible continuations with different local interaction intents. A fluent response may therefore advance the dialogue through an inappropriate intent, such as acceptance rather than repair. Our key insight is that controllable user simulation should separate which local interaction intent the next user turn should realize from how that intent is expressed in language. We introduce UserIDA (User Intent-Directive Alignment), which exposes interaction intent as an explicit per-turn directive. UserIDA defines a six-way intent interface, learns directive-conditioned generation through supervised fine-tuning, and uses intent-calibrated policy optimization during group-based reinforcement learning. The reward preserves composite response quality while ensuring that intent-violating candidates rank below compliant alternatives in mixed groups. On LMSYS-USP, UserIDA achieves 86.6\% intent accuracy, outperforming the strongest dedicated user-simulator baseline by 24.3 percentage points while improving semantic and stylistic similarity. In within-context interventions, it realizes at least four of the six target intents in 91.7\% of evaluated dialogue states, compared with 22.9\% for the strongest external baseline. These results establish per-turn intent control as a complementary dimension to response fidelity in user simulation.

</details>


### [83] [Reducing Pretraining-Generation Mismatch in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09424)
*Xiaocheng Lu,Huabin Liu,Song Guo,Jianguo Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PCD（Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion）预训练目标，用于弥合扩散语言模型（dLLM）预训练与提示条件生成之间的不匹配。PCD将自回归前缀监督与无偏移后缀去噪相结合，仅修改注意力掩码、损坏掩码和标签构造，无需自回归解码器或新的推理模式。在LLaDA2-Mini和Qwen-1.7B骨干上，PCD相比原生dLLM基线分别获得4.2%和14.2%的相对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型训练与使用天然对齐（训练和生成都基于干净左上下文），但原生dLLM预训练会同时随机损坏提示词和续写词，削弱了提示条件生成所需的干净前缀接口，导致dLLM在提示续写任务上存在性能差距。

Method: PCD通过三个层面的改动实现：1）修改注意力掩码，使前缀部分可互相注意而类似于AR模型；2）修改损坏掩码，只对未知续写部分（后缀）进行扩散去噪，保持前缀干净；3）修改标签构造，对前缀进行自回归监督。同时将样本内前缀条件化与样本间目标混合分离，以便单独评估局部对齐信号和批次级混合旋钮。

Result: 在LLaDA2-Mini上，PCD在六个基准平均上相比原生dLLM稳定基线获得+2.56点（4.2%相对提升）；在Qwen-1.7B主机制对比中获得+4.86点（14.2%相对提升）。

Conclusion: 将预训练上下文分布与提示条件生成对齐，可以在不改变推理方式的情况下，显著恢复dLLM在提示续写任务中的性能差距，验证了训练与使用对齐原则在扩散语言模型中的重要性。

Abstract: Autoregressive language models align training and use: generation conditions on a clean prompt, and training predicts future tokens from clean left context. Diffusion language models offer parallel denoising, but native dLLM pretraining can randomly corrupt prompt and continuation tokens together, weakening the clean-prefix interface needed for prompt-conditioned generation. We identify this mismatch for prompt continuation and propose PCD (Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion), a pretraining objective that combines AR prefix supervision with no-shift suffix denoising. At the training-objective level, PCD changes the attention mask, corruption mask, and label construction in continued pretraining; it does not require an autoregressive decoder, verifier, or new inference mode. By supervising the clean-prefix side autoregressively and applying diffusion only to the unknown continuation, PCD makes the local training interface resemble how block-diffusion models are queried at evaluation time. We further separate intra-sample prefix conditioning from inter-sample objective mixing, allowing us to identify the local alignment signal separately from the optional batch-level mixing knob. Across LLaDA2-Mini and Qwen-1.7B backbones, PCD consistently improves over same-family native dLLM stable baselines, reaching a 4.2% relative gain on the main LLaDA2-Mini six-benchmark average (+2.56 points) and a 14.2% relative gain in the primary Qwen mechanism comparison (+4.86 points). These results suggest that aligning the pretraining context distribution with prompt-conditioned generation can recover a measurable part of the dLLM continuation gap without changing inference.

</details>


### [84] [ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09432)
*Róisín Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ZetaGPT，一种无需显式位置编码的混合语言模型架构。该架构在每个模型块中先施加因果状态空间方程（SSM）再执行自注意力，使状态循环动态将序列位置信息隐式编码到token表示中，从而摆脱对位置嵌入或RoPE等显式位置编码的依赖。ZetaGPT提供了完整开源的端到端训练流程（数据构建、分词器训练、预训练、SFT、RLHF和纯强化学习的CoT推理），是首个无显式位置编码的开源小语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer自注意力的计算是置换等变的，天然缺乏表征token顺序的内在机制。现有方法（如可学习位置嵌入、RoPE）将位置信息视为架构获得的能力而非模型固有属性。本文的动机是探索无需位置编码的架构，通过因果状态空间方程在注意力之前隐式编码位置信息，实现位置编码自由的语言模型。

Method: 在每个Transformer块的自注意力计算之前，先施加一个因果状态空间方程。循环状态动态将序列中的顺序信息编码进token表示中，使后续的自注意力层能够在无需显式位置编码的情况下操作于位置感知的表示。在此基础上构建紧凑型混合语言模型ZetaGPT，并提供完整的开源训练管线（数据集构建、分词器训练、预训练、SFT、RLHF、纯RL驱动的CoT推理）。

Result: ZetaGPT验证了通过因果SSM隐式编码位置信息替代显式位置编码的可行性。它作为首个无显式位置编码的开源小语言模型，提供了一个紧凑、可复现的参考实现，支持从零开始训练涵盖预训练到RLHF的完整流程。

Conclusion: 因果状态空间方程可以有效地将序列顺序信息隐式注入token表示，使后续自注意力层无需显式位置编码即可处理位置感知信息，同时保留自注意力的表达能力。ZetaGPT为位置编码自由语言模型的研究和复现提供了一个开放的基础平台。

Abstract: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.

</details>


### [85] [Learning Preference Adaptation for Large Language Model Personalization via Verbal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09507)
*Yuting Liu,Wei Wu,Jianzhe Zhao,Guibing Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出AlignXada，一种无需训练的元学习框架，通过语词增强学习自动生成可复用的文本细化策略，将通用用户偏好摘要适配为任务特定的偏好视图，在13个任务和3个下游模型上平均提升3.82分，同时仅保留22.8%的原始token，并优于36个细胞中的RAG基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的通用用户偏好摘要包含大量与特定下游任务无关的信息，直接使用会浪费上下文容量并引入跨任务干扰，而手工设计任务特定的偏好视图难以规模化。

Method: 提出AlignXada，一个无需训练的元学习框架，通过语词（言语）强化学习迭代优化元学习器，诱导出可复用的文本细化策略，将通用偏好摘要自适应地转化为任务特定的偏好表示，保留足够的决策相关证据并移除冗余上下文。

Result: 在13个任务与3个下游模型构成的39个任务-模型组合中，平均提升3.82分，改善了33个组合，仅保留22.8%的原始偏好token，并在36个组合中优于RAG基线。扩展的忠实度分析表明细化后的偏好保持对源偏好的高度忠实，同时保留任务相关的个性化信号。

Conclusion: 偏好侧适配可以作为通用记忆构建的实用补充，支持终身个性化代理系统在有限上下文下高效利用用户偏好信息。

Abstract: Natural language user preferences provide an interpretable interface for LLM personalization. However, universal preference summaries often contain information irrelevant to a particular downstream task. Directly supplying the full preference summary therefore wastes context capacity and introduces cross-task distraction, while manually designing task-specific preference views is difficult to scale. In this work, we study \emph{task-specific preference adaptation}: given a universal user preference summary and a downstream task, derive a task-conditioned representation that preserves sufficient decision-relevant evidence while removing redundant context. To this end, we propose \textsc{AlignXada}, a training-free meta-learning framework that induces reusable textual refinement policies for adapting universal preference summaries to task-specific ones. The refinement policy is iteratively optimized by a meta learner through verbal reinforcement learning. Across 13 tasks and three downstream models (39 task--model cells), \textsc{AlignXada} achieves an average gain of 3.82 points, improving 33 cells while retaining only 22.8\% of the original profile tokens and outperforming RAG in 36 cells. An extended faithfulness analysis further shows that the refined profiles remain largely grounded in the source preferences while preserving task-relevant personalization signals, suggesting that profile-side adaptation serves as a practical complement to universal memory construction for lifelong personalized agents.

</details>


### [86] [Build it, Break it, Repeat: Benchmarking and improving LLM-manipulated disinformation detection in social media posts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09510)
*Kevin Thomas,Milosz Kasprzyk,Reuel C Igbokwe Onuigbo,Elliott Pert,Cameron Tovey,João A. Leite,Olesya Razuvayevskaya,Carolina Scarton*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BiBiR（Build it, Break it, Repeat）迭代框架，用于压力测试社交媒体上机器生成虚假信息检测器的对抗鲁棒性。五轮迭代中，最佳攻击技术（回译结合LLM人格改写）实现了95%的标签翻转率且保留原文语义；最佳检测器为带动态锚点切换（DASS）的三元组对比模型，平均准确率达72.68%，比强基线高出15个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态基准评测无法反映检测器在面对刻意变换以规避分类的虚假信息时的真实表现。随着LLM使大规模生成和改写误导性内容变得容易，需要一种能够迭代测试检测器在对抗条件下鲁棒性的评估框架。

Method: 将"Build it, Break it, Fix it"框架改造为BiBiR（Build it, Break it, Repeat），通过五轮迭代对抗会话，系统性地变换虚假信息帖子以规避检测，同时评估检测器的鲁棒性。攻击方结合回译（back-translation）与LLM人格化改写；防御方采用带动态锚点切换（DASS）架构的三元组对比模型。

Result: 最佳攻击技术达到95%的标签翻转率（LFR）且保留原帖语义；最佳检测模型（三元组对比+DASS）平均准确率72.68%，在最鲁棒的攻击集上比微调e5-small-LoRA强基线高出15个百分点。

Conclusion: 迭代框架能有效暴露检测器的弱点并推动鲁棒性提升，但仍需语义保持分析以区分有效的对抗性规避与改变原始虚假信息主张语义的变换。

Abstract: Detecting machine-generated disinformation on social media is increasingly difficult as large language models (LLMs) make it easier to generate and rewrite misleading content at scale. Static benchmark evaluations, measuring detector performance on fixed held-out datasets, do not capture how detectors behave when posts are deliberately transformed to evade classification. This paper adapts the Build it, Break it, Fix it framework into Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR): iterative sessions designed to stress-test detectors' robustness under iterative adversarial conditions, evaluating whether models remain reliable when disinformation posts are systematically transformed to evade classification. Across five iterations, the findings show that the best adversarial breakers' transformations came from a combination of back-translation and LLM persona-based rewriting, with the best performing technique achieving a 95% label flip rate (LFR), whilst still preserving the meaning of the original posts. The best builders' model was a triplet contrastive model with a dynamic anchor switching (DASS) architecture, which achieved an average accuracy of 72.68%, outperforming the strong baseline (a fine-tuned e5-small-LoRA) by 15 percentage points on the most robust set of breakers' adversarial attacks. The results demonstrate that an iterative framework best exposes detector weaknesses and pushes robustness improvements; however, it may still require semantic preservation analysis to distinguish valid adversarial evasion from transformations that changed the original disinformation claims' meaning.

</details>


### [87] [TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09538)
*Vincent Cohen-Addad,Dimitris Paparas,Ernest van Wijland,Max Springer,Julien Canitrot-Paradis,Honghao Lin,David Woodruff,Adarsh Kumarappan,Rajesh Jayaram,Rudrajit Das,Lalit Jain,Ola Svensson,Silvio Lattanzi,Mislav Balunovic,Theophane Weber,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: TCS-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型在理论计算机科学证明生成能力的基准测试，包含来自STOC、FOCS和SODA等顶级会议论文中的定理证明任务，并配备了一个经人类专家标注验证、准确率超过90%的验证代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前缺乏一个专注于研究级理论计算机科学（TCS）证明生成的基准测试来系统评估大语言模型在该领域的推理和证明能力。

Method: 从STOC、FOCS和SODA等顶级TCS会议论文中提取定理证明任务，为每个任务提供必要的上下文以保证证明的自包含性；通过验证代理自动检查生成证明的正确性，并将该验证器与人类专家对目标陈述和生成证明对的判断进行对比校准。

Result: 参考验证器在专家标注数据集上达到了超过90%的准确率，表明其能够可靠地验证LLM生成的证明。

Conclusion: TCS-Bench为评估LLM在顶级难度TCS定理证明能力提供了一个基准平台，其验证机制经过人类专家校准，可为后续TCS证明生成研究提供可靠的评估标准。

Abstract: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier against human-expert proof judgements on a set of target statements and generated proofs pairs. Our reference verifier achieves over 90% accuracy on the expert labeled set.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开的阿拉伯语目标特定立场检测数据集稀缺，尤其是用于评估跨目标泛化的数据集不足，限制了该领域的研究进展。

Method: 构建包含996条手工注释的阿拉伯语推文扩展数据集（Mawqif-v2 Extension），覆盖三个公开目标，采用原始Mawqif标注方案对每条约标注立场、情感和讽刺三类标签；同时使用多种阿拉伯语和多语言Transformer模型以及零样本LLM建立基线。

Conclusion: Mawqif-v2 Extension填补了阿拉伯语跨目标立场检测评估数据的空白，为后续研究提供了一个标准化、可复现的基准。

Abstract: Publicly available Arabic datasets for target-specific stance detection remain limited, particularly for evaluating cross-target generalization. This paper presents the Mawqif-v2 Extension, consisting of 996 manually annotated Arabic tweets collected from three public targets: Women Driving, E-Cars, and Trimester System. Each tweet is annotated with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm labels following the original Mawqif annotation scheme. The released extension is intended as a held-out evaluation set for assessing model generalization to both semantically related and previously unseen targets, while the original Mawqif dataset is used for training and development. In addition, we establish baseline results using several Arabic and multilingual transformer models, as well as zero-shot large language models (LLMs), to facilitate reproducible evaluation. Together with the original Mawqif dataset, the Mawqif-v2 Extension provides a benchmark for evaluating cross-target generalization in Arabic stance detection.

</details>


### [89] [ELBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Education-Facing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09548)
*Yilin Jiang,Xiaorong Zhu,Fei Tan,Zicheng Zhang,Kaiyi Huang,Yang Yu,Zexuan Fei,Yiming Luo,Keqian Li,Hao Hao,Aimin Zhou,Guangtao Zhai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ELBench是首个在同一协议下综合评估教育场景大模型四项要求（通用能力、安全可信、基础教育、高阶培育）的基准，评估了9个模型，发现模块级画像比聚合分数更具信息量、国产模型在安全模块领先、教育专用模型并未在教育模块领先且所有模型在高阶培育上存在系统性盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在教育领域的部署日益广泛（担任导师、助教、内容生成器等），这些角色对模型提出了超出普通问答的复合要求：须同时具备准确性、敏感提示下的安全性、教学实用性以及与教育目标的一致性。现有基准大多割裂地评估这些需求，缺乏一个将教育场景适配性作为整体画像来评估的基准，因此亟需一个统一的综合评估框架。

Method: 构建ELBench基准，在同一协议下对同一批模型评估四个模块：通用能力（General Capability）、安全与可信（Safety and Trustworthiness）、基础教育（Basic Education）、高阶培育（High-Level Cultivation）。数据来源结合了精选的公开资源与新增合成的安全和培育数据。评估了9个模型，包括7个前沿通用模型和2个教育专用模型。

Result: 三项主要发现：（1）模块级画像比单一聚合分数更具区分力——排名前六的模型在总分上统计上不可区分，但各模块领先者差异显著，且安全与实用教学呈负相关（r=-0.83）；（2）国产模型在安全模块（该套件中区分度最高的模块）领先，这一优势在区域特定规范内容上最大，在普适危害内容上收窄但未消失；（3）两个教育专用模型在任一教育模块均未领先，且所有模型在高阶培育的结构化判断任务上存在系统性盲区——均收敛于同一非参考选项，偏向教学风格而非对既定目标的适配，导致该模块分数普遍偏低且无法区分模型。

Conclusion: ELBench揭示了教育场景下大模型的真实能力画像远比单一综合分数复杂：模块间存在显著的权衡（安全与教学实用性负相关），国产模型在安全方面具备优势，而所有模型（包括教育专用模型）在高阶培育任务上均存在能力盲区。这引发了关于领域后训练是否在教育任务上跟上通用前沿系统的未决问题。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in education as tutors, teaching assistants, and content generators. These roles place demands that ordinary question answering does not: a usable education-facing model is supposed to be accurate, safe under sensitive prompts, instructionally useful, and aligned with pedagogical goals at the same time. Existing benchmarks evaluate these requirements largely in isolation, so none assesses education-facing suitability as an integrated profile. We introduce ELBench, the first benchmark to evaluate all four requirements (General Capability, Safety and Trustworthiness, Basic Education, and High-Level Cultivation) on the same models under a common protocol, combining curated public sources with newly synthesized safety and cultivation data. We evaluate nine models, seven frontier general-purpose systems and two education-specialized variants, and report three findings. First, module-level profiles are more informative than a single aggregate: the top six models are statistically indistinguishable on overall score, yet their module leaders differ substantially, and safety is anti-correlated with practical teaching (r = -0.83). Second, the Chinese-developed models lead the safety module, the most discriminative in the suite; this advantage is largest on region-specific normative content and narrows, but does not vanish, on universal-harm content. Third, the two education-specialized models lead neither education module, and on High-Level Cultivation all models share a systematic blind spot: on the structured judgment task they converge on the same non-reference option, favoring pedagogical style over fit to the stated goal, so the module scores uniformly low and does not separate models. This raises, but does not resolve, whether domain post-training keeps pace with frontier systems on education tasks.

</details>


### [90] [Pragmatic Attack Surface: Vulnerabilities of Implicit Context in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09551)
*Bocheng Chen,Han Zi,Roucheng Ou,Yawei Liu,Minyue Chen,Zimo Qi,Rongrong Wang,Guangliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"语用攻击面"（pragmatic attack surface）这一新型LLM安全漏洞概念，指出人类语言依赖隐含的语用上下文（如世界知识、社会规范）来理解，而现有安全对齐方法未能充分利用这些隐含上下文，导致攻击者可通过操纵语用语境绕过LLM安全机制，实验表明该方法在多种开源和闭源模型上显著优于基线攻击方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的安全对齐算法虽然能够缓解直接的自然语言攻击（即显式语言线索攻击），但人类语言本质上基于语用学，需要依赖隐含的上下文（如世界知识、社会规范）才能正确解读。这种隐含上下文通常不在人类语言中直接表达，也未被安全对齐方法充分利用，导致人类语言理解与安全对齐之间存在根本性的不匹配，从而暴露LLM的新漏洞。

Method: 作者识别并形式化了"语用攻击面"这一漏洞类别，利用人类语言理解与安全对齐方法之间的不匹配，通过操纵隐含的语用上下文（如利用社会规范、世界知识等隐含语境）来构造攻击提示，从而绕过LLM的安全机制。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的攻击方法在多种开源和闭源LLM上均实现了较高的攻击成功率，且显著优于现有的基线攻击方法。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了一个此前未被充分认识的LLM安全漏洞——语用攻击面，表明仅依赖现有的安全对齐方法不足以防御利用隐含语用上下文的攻击，需要在安全对齐中更充分地纳入语用知识，以缩小人类语言理解与安全对齐之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: In the era of large language models (LLMs), attackers often manipulate natural language to elicit unsafe or harmful outputs, creating a new natural language attack surface unique to LLM-based systems, where attacks directly exploit explicit linguistic cues in user prompts to bypass the safety mechanism of LLMs. However, such attacks can often be mitigated by existing safety alignment algorithms. On the other hand, human language is inherently grounded in pragmatics, necessitating typical context to interpret language, e.g., world knowledge, social norms. However, such contexts are often implicit because they are not directly expressed in human language and are not sufficiently leveraged in safety alignment, creating a fundamental mismatch between human language interpretation and safety alignment approaches. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch exposes vulnerabilities in LLMs. We refer to this vulnerability as the pragmatic attack surface, which can be exploited to achieve high attack success rates. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms baseline attack methods across various open-source and closed-source models by a substantial margin.

</details>


### [91] [Se-DPO: Self-Evolving Token Credit for Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09568)
*Wenxiao Zhao,Shu Wang,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Se-DPO（自进化token信用DPO），针对DPO中所有token被均匀对待的问题，提出根据每个token对偏好信号的贡献程度动态调节其KL正则化权重。Se-DPO从模型自身演化中的内部信号推导token信用，并基于每个token贡献的强度与置信度进行校准，无需外部模型，仅增加轻量级校准网络。在AlpacaEval 2上提升最高9.8分，在Arena-Hard上提升最高12.2分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO通过均匀求和聚合token级log概率比，隐式假设所有token对偏好信号贡献相等。但实际上不同token对偏好结果的贡献各不相同，且静态token信用（与隐式奖励幅值成正比）在训练过程中会随着奖励信号的演化而逐渐失配，导致训练效率与效果下降。

Method: Se-DPO提出一种动态机制：从模型自身在DPO训练中演化的内部信号中实时推导每个token的信用值。具体地，(1) 推导出有效的token信用与该token隐式奖励的幅值成正比；(2) 由于奖励信号在不同位置的可靠性不同，Se-DPO基于每个token贡献的强度与置信度来校准token信用；(3) 通过一个轻量级的校准网络实现，无需外部模型且计算开销极小。

Result: 实验表明，Se-DPO相比标准DPO在AlpacaEval 2上最多提升9.8个点，在Arena-Hard上最多提升12.2个点，验证了动态token信用机制的有效性。

Conclusion: Se-DPO通过自演化的token信用机制解决了DPO中token贡献不均与静态信用失配的问题，在不引入外部模型和显著计算开销的前提下显著提升了对齐性能，为DPO类方法提供了更精细的token级偏好建模思路。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aggregates token-level log-probability ratios via uniform summation, implicitly treating all tokens as contributing equally to the preference signal. However, the contribution of individual tokens to the preference signal varies. We introduce token credit, which modulates each token's KL regularization based on its contribution to the preference outcome. We derive that effective token credit is proportional to the magnitude of each token's implicit reward, and observe that this quantity evolves substantially during training. This implies that static token credit becomes increasingly misaligned as training progresses. In this work, we propose Se-DPO (Self-Evolving Token Credit for DPO), a live mechanism that derives token credit from the model's own evolving internal signals during DPO training. Since the reward signal varies in reliability across positions, Se-DPO calibrates token credit based on both the strength and the confidence of each token's contribution. Se-DPO requires no external models, adding only a lightweight calibration network with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that Se-DPO improves over DPO by up to 9.8 points on AlpacaEval~2 and 12.2 points on Arena-Hard.

</details>


### [92] [MDB-Link: Hierarchical Schema Linking for Multi-Database Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09588)
*Beiyu Xu,Zhenyu Wu,Jiaoyan Chen,Riza theresa Batista-navarro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MDB-Link，一个面向多数据库场景的分层schema链接框架。它通过全局索引检索相关列、聚合证据筛选候选数据库，并利用预算感知的LLM进行数据库重排序、表选择和列定位，在MMQA、Spider2-Snow和BIRD-dev上显著超越现有方法，且运行效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Text-to-SQL研究和基准假设目标数据库已知，忽略了在大型异构数据库集合中需要先定位目标数据库再生成SQL的真实场景。这一设定空白导致现有方法无法处理多数据库路由问题。

Method: MDB-Link采用三层级联架构：1) 从全局索引中检索与问题相关的列；2) 聚合检索证据以初步短list候选数据库；3) 利用预算感知的LLM进行数据库重排序、表选择和列grounding，逐步压缩schema子集。

Result: 基于Qwen2.5-14B，MDB-Link在MMQA、Spider2-Snow和BIRD-dev上于数据库定位和列选择方面超越LinkAlign，schema子集大小接近gold schema。Exact Match在三个基准上分别从16.88→51.41、2.50→9.17、12.52→38.01，且运行速度快于LinkAlign和AutoLink。

Conclusion: 分层schema缩减方案能有效提升多数据库场景下Text-to-SQL的性能，在准确性、schema紧凑性和运行效率三方面均优于现有方法，证明了层次化schema链接框架的实用价值。

Abstract: Traditional Text-to-SQL research and benchmarks assume a known target database, overlooking settings in which a query must be routed within a large, heterogeneous database collection. We therefore study schema linking in a multi-database setting, where the system must first locate the target database and then construct a compact, SQL-relevant schema for generation. We propose MDB-Link, a hierarchical schema-linking framework that retrieves question-relevant columns from a global index, aggregates retrieval evidence to shortlist databases, and uses a budget-aware large language model (LLM) for database reranking, table selection, and column grounding. With Qwen2.5-14B, MDB-Link outperforms LinkAlign on MMQA, Spider2-Snow, and BIRD-dev in database localization and column selection while producing schema subsets close in size to the gold schemas. Exact match improves from 16.88 to 51.41 on MMQA, 2.50 to 9.17 on Spider2-Snow, and 12.52 to 38.01 on BIRD-dev. MDB-Link also runs faster than LinkAlign and AutoLink, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical schema reduction for downstream SQL generation.

</details>


### [93] [Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09624)
*Mingyu Luo,Ming Deng,Zilang Qiu,Yiming Cheng,Ci Tao,Xue Tan,Sijin Sun,Yangfu Li,Ping Chen,Jun Dai,Xiaoyan Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文审计了内部安全分数用于拦截越狱攻击的推断有效性，指出攻击成功是目标模型、解码策略和评判器共同作用的结果，而安全分数仅衡量提示意图。作者提出Active Attention Probing（主动注意力探测）方法，使用内容无关的固定测量坐标，在匹配设计中配对各基础目标和包装/未包装版本并生成真实补全。实验发现包装使有害生成率从0.05升至0.27，而有害意图AUROC从0.936降至0.803，攻击变得更危险但提示看起来更安全；在包装的有害提示中结果AUROC仅为0.220，成功攻击排名反而低于失败攻击。该反转在多种测量通道、三个目标模型、七类攻击家族和两个独立评判器下均复现，且分布偏移先侵蚀校准和阈值迁移，其次才损伤排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全过滤器基于内部安全分数在生成前判断提示，其验证逻辑依赖于分数能否区分有害提示与良性提示，但这种区分能力被当作分数也能捕捉实际成功攻击的证据。本文指出这种推断存在根本性缺陷：有害意图是提示的属性，而越狱成功是特定目标模型、解码策略和评判器共同产生的后期结果，二者并非同一种量。基于衡量错误量的分数调优过滤器，只会把误报预算浪费在本会失败的攻击上。论文旨在系统审计这一推断的有效性。

Method: 论文引入Active Attention Probing（主动注意力探测）方法，与传统注意力测量（通常在提示相关位置读取信号）不同，它提供内容无关的固定测量坐标，使包装（wrapper）不会同时改变被评判的内容和信号提取位置。通过将每个基础目标配对一个普通版本和一个包装版本，并从目标模型生成真实补全，在匹配设计下比较有害意图AUROC与结果AUROC。

Result: 在Llama上，包装将有害生成率从0.05提升至0.27，而有害意图AUROC从0.936降至0.803——攻击变得更危险但评分让其看起来更安全。在包装的有害提示中，结果AUROC仅为0.220，即成功的攻击排名反而低于失败的攻击。该反转在罕见token通道、被动通道和检测器衍生通道的同等匹配设计下复现，并跨三个目标模型、七类攻击家族和两个独立评判器保持一致。此外，分布偏移首先侵蚀校准和阈值迁移能力，其次才损害排序性能。

Conclusion: 内部安全分数衡量提示意图与预测实际攻击成功之间存在根本性错位，依赖意图分离分数来过滤真实攻击会系统性地浪费误报预算。攻击者只需进行风格化包装即可使提示在安全分数下显得更安全，同时实际提高攻击成功率。这一现象高度稳健，表明现有安全评分体系需要重新设计，不能以意图区分度作为攻击成功预测的代理指标。

Abstract: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.

</details>


### [94] [How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09717)
*Hasan Mahmud,Khawaja Abaid Ullah,Mohammad Javad Khojasteh,Jamison Heard,Prabu David*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过三项研究检验了LLM是否能够作为有效的"社会评判者"评估社会吸引力。34个LLM对12个基于理论构建的人格档案评分表现出高度的运行间稳定性和一致的三层排序；LLM对性别呈现不敏感；198名人类参与者的评分复现了三层结构且档案排序与LLM一致，但LLM对人设评分呈现两端极化（更极端的褒贬）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于替代人类进行主观评估，但其作为"社会评判者"的有效性尚不明确。需要系统检验LLM基于理论驱动的人格档案进行社会吸引力评估时，与人类判断之间的一致性、稳定性和偏差，以验证其效度。

Method: 研究设计包含三个子研究：研究1中34个LLM对基于十个心理与关系构念构建的12个三层（社会吸引/混合/不吸引）人格档案进行三轮重复评分；研究2采用六个匹配的姓名+代词档案对以及性别中立姓名的代词单独测试，检验对性别呈现的敏感度；研究3中198名人类参与者对研究2的六个匹配档案进行评分，并与LLM评分比较。

Result: 研究1：LLM间存在整体评分高低偏差，但单模型跨运行稳定，三层排序一致，相对档案排序高一致性。研究2：性别呈现无显著影响。研究3：人类评分复现三层结构，档案排序与LLM一致；但LLM对吸引性档案评分更高、对不吸引性档案评分更低（极化效应），两组均无显著的性别呈现主效应。

Conclusion: LLM在评估社会吸引力时表现出与人类一致的三层结构和档案排序，支持其作为社会评判者的初步效度；但LLM呈现评分极化偏差，应通过校准或参照人类评分分布加以缓解。总体而言LLM有潜力进行此类主观评估，但需谨慎对待其极端化倾向。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.

</details>


### [95] [REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09765)
*Igor Sterner,Mirella Lapata,Alex Lascarides,Frank Keller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文重新定义了音频描述（AD）生成任务，提出模型需同时决定"描述什么"和"何时描述"，并发布了REFRAMED数据集（206部电影的2023个视频、3302个场景，含专业AD转录、字幕和对齐剧本），以及一个手动策展的挑战集和多参考评估协议。实验表明现有SOTA系统远低于人类专家水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AD生成方法将任务简化为剪辑级字幕生成，预先指定了描述的内容和时机，且依赖有噪声的转录和对齐流程，缺乏用于建模叙事上下文的丰富平行数据。作者希望通过新的任务设定和高质量数据集弥合这一差距。

Method: 1) 提出AD生成的新形式化：模型必须联合决策描述内容与描述时机（插入到对话间隙中，仅传达理解叙事所需的关键视觉信息）；2) 构建REFRAMED数据集，包含206部电影的2023个视频、3302个场景，提供美国和英国两版专业AD转录、专业字幕及对齐的剧本；3) 提供手动策展的挑战集，将完整电影与多个AD参考配对；4) 设计利用对话间隙和多参考比较的评估协议。

Result: 实验评估了SOTA AD系统和多模态大语言模型，结果表明它们优于简单基线，但距离专家人类表现仍有很大差距。作者认为该数据集和基准为视频理解研究建立了新基础。

Conclusion: REFRAMED数据集和基准重新定义了AD生成的研究范式，使模型需要同时处理内容选择与时机决策两个维度，揭示了现有模型与人类专家之间的显著性能差距，为未来视频理解和AD生成研究提供了新的基础设施和评估标准。

Abstract: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.

</details>


### [96] [Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09766)
*Pinzhen Chen,Koel Dutta Chowdhury,Xiaoya Xu,David Tan,Doreen Osmelak,Ona de Gibert,Ariun-Erdene Tumurchuluun,Ashok Urlana,Fedor Sizov,Hale Sirin,Jesujoba Alabi,Karrar Talib Abed,Mateusz Klimaszewski,Nikolay Bogoychev,Niyati Bafna,Patricia Schmidtova,Preksha Manjunath Shanbhag,Sherrie Shen,Vilem Zouhar,Vivek Iyer,Yasser Hamidullah,Yusser Al Ghussin,Zheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出源对比评估方法，构建了Cultivar数据集（FLORES的本地化子集），用于评估多语言翻译模型在不同文化语域下的鲁棒性，并对32个开源模型进行了基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多语言翻译基准通常以英语为源语言翻译成其他语言，将语言对作为评估单元，这种设计容易受到数据污染，且忽视了语域和文化因素对翻译质量的影响。

Method: 提出源对比评估方法，构建Cultivar（FLORES的本地化子集），通过将本地化内容与其非本地化对应内容配对，利用性能差异来探测数据污染程度和本地化鲁棒性。

Result: 对32个开源模型进行基准测试后发现：MT专用模型鲁棒性较差，少数模型可能过拟合FLORES数据集，且模型无论使用何种语言，对美式内容的翻译效果普遍优于其他语域。

Conclusion: 现有翻译基准的设计存在数据污染和本地化忽视的问题，源对比评估框架（Cultivar）能够更有效地揭示模型在本地化鲁棒性和过拟合方面的缺陷。

Abstract: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.

</details>


### [97] [Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09767)
*Abner Hernandez,Tomás Arias Vergara,Daiqi Liu,Andreas Maier,Paula Andrea Pérez-Toro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了音频基础模型PhonoQ的语音学特征表示是否能为音频-发音运动建模提供有用信息。通过将PhonoQ Conformer模块的表示与发音轮廓特征结合，在未见语音和未见受试者两种设置下，相比WavLM-large和HuBERT-large基线，该方法在音系特征（方式、部位、清浊、元音高度和舌位前后）的macro-F1以及39音素细粒度分类上均有提升。仅使用发音轮廓的推理设置中，音频教师的监督信号也能带来适度且一致的增益。后验分析揭示了与闪音化/t/、/t/-/r/后移或塞擦化、鼻音部位同化一致的表面敏感模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时MRI能够观测言语过程中的声道发音运动，但将这些发音模式映射到音系和语音类别仍具挑战性。作者希望利用PhonoQ（一个基于音频、训练识别结构化语音学特征的模型）的表示来改进音频-发音运动建模，从而更好地建立发音与音系类别之间的对应关系。

Method: 从PhonoQ的Conformer模块中提取表示（其训练受方式、部位、清浊和元音特征监督）；使用发音轮廓和同步音频特征，将整合PhonoQ表示的模型与WavLM-large和HuBERT-large基线进行比较；在未见语音和未见受试者设置下评估；并进行仅使用发音轮廓的推理设置，通过音频教师监督训练。最后进行后验分析。

Result: PhonoQ表示显著提升音系特征（方式、部位、清浊、元音高度、元音舌位前后）的macro-F1，以及39音素分类表现。轮廓-only推理中，音频教师监督带来适度但一致的增益。后验分析显示与闪音化/t/、/t/-/r/后移或塞擦化、鼻音同化一致的发音模式。

Conclusion: 音频衍生的语音学信息可以从音频模型部分迁移到发音运动模型，PhonoQ的语音学特征表示是音频-发音运动建模的有效辅助信号，且能提供可解释的多音位变体敏感的表面发音模式。

Abstract: Real-time MRI makes it possible to observe vocal-tract articulation during speech, but mapping these articulatory patterns to phonetic and phonological categories remains challenging. We investigate whether PhonoQ, an audio-based model trained to recognize structured phonological features, provides useful information for audio--articulatory modeling. Specifically, we extract representations from PhonoQ's Conformer module, whose training is shaped by supervision for manner, place, voicing, and vowel features. Using articulatory contours with synchronized audio-derived features, we compare WavLM-large and HuBERT-large baselines with models that incorporate PhonoQ-derived representations. Across unseen-speech and unseen-subject settings, these features improve macro-F1 for phonological targets including manner, place, voicing, vowel height, and vowel backness, and also improve fine-grained 39-phoneme classification. In a contour-only inference setting, audio-derived teacher supervision yields modest but consistent gains over contour-only training, indicating that phonological information from synchronized audio can be partially transferred to articulatory models. Finally, posterior analyses show interpretable surface-sensitive patterns consistent with flapping-like /t/ realizations, /t/-/r/ retraction or affrication, and nasal place assimilation.

</details>


### [98] [PragMatch: Separating Pragmatic Incongruity from Cross-Modal Mismatch in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09772)
*Zhanna Mukhametsharip,Vera Demberg,Varsha Suresh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PragMatch，一个基于MMSD2.0构建的3,000对图文对照基准，用于系统性评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态讽刺检测中的捷径学习问题。通过掩码和注入实验证明LVLM的预测严重依赖词汇、OCR和风格等表面线索而非真正的图文关系推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然LVLMs在多模态基准上表现优异，但其是否真正理解图文关系而非依赖表面相关性的问题尚不明确，尤其在多模态讽刺检测中——讽刺识别的关键在于理解语用不协调而非将讽刺简单视为图文不匹配，因此需要系统评估LVLMs是否在讽刺检测中陷入捷径学习。

Method: 作者引入PragMatch基准，包含从MMSD2.0衍生的3,000对图文对，涵盖原始讽刺样本及构建的字面义和硬负样本对；通过系统性掩码识别有影响力的捷径线索，并通过定向注入实验评估其对模型预测的影响。

Result: 实验结果显示，LVLMs的预测明显受词汇、OCR提取文本和风格线索的影响——即使图文底层关系保持不变，注入的表面信号也会导致模型预测发生显著变化，证明当前LVLMs存在捷径学习问题。

Conclusion: 本研究揭示了当前LVLMs在多模态讽刺检测中依赖表面线索而非深层语用推理的局限性，PragMatch为评估超越表面级图文对齐的多模态语用推理提供了系统性测试平台。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason about relationships between images and text or rely on superficial correlations, known as shortcut learning. This question is particularly important for multimodal sarcasm detection, where successful prediction depends on recognizing pragmatic incongruity rather than treating sarcasm as simple image-text mismatch. We introduce PragMatch, a controlled benchmark of 3,000 image-text pairs derived from MMSD2.0, including original sarcastic examples and constructed literal and hard-negative pairs. We identify influential shortcut cues through systematic masking and evaluate their impact through targeted injection experiments. Our results show that LVLM predictions are sensitive to lexical, OCR-derived and stylistic cues, with injected surface signals causing substantial changes in model predictions despite unchanged underlying image-text relationships. Our findings reveal limitations in current LVLMs while PragMatch provides a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal pragmatic reasoning beyond surface-level image-text alignment.

</details>


### [99] [KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09779)
*Ghanshyam Verma,Simanta Sarkar,Devishree Pillai,Hotaka Shiokawa,Yourong Xu,Fiona Veazey,Peter Hubbert,Hui Su,Paul Buitelaar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出KGCaRe，一种混合RAG方法，结合神经检索与基于LLM生成的知识图谱上的符号推理，通过迭代图遍历提取相关三元组并结合语义检索的文本段落来回答复杂条件性问题，在多个LLM和数据集上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂条件性问答在领域特定场景下仍然具有挑战性，通用LLM和传统RAG方法在此类任务上表现不佳，需要结合结构化与非结构化知识来提升推理和回答准确性。

Method: KGCaRe采用混合架构：1）通过多提示（multi-prompt）提取策略从文档中构建知识图谱并存入图数据库；2）同时将文档嵌入向量存储用于神经检索；3）执行创新的LLM引导的迭代图遍历，提取相关三元组、剪枝无关信息，并在初始遍历不足时利用额外线索实体再次遍历；4）将路径形式的三元组与语义检索的文本段落一起输入定制的KGCaRe提示词，生成带解释的回答。

Result: 在两个复杂条件性问答数据集上，KGCaRe在Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5和GPT-4o等多个LLM上一致优于Vanilla LLM、Code Prompt、Text Prompt、Think-on-Graph、Vanilla RAG和HybridContextQA等基线方法。

Conclusion: 将LLM生成的知识图谱与神经检索结合，并采用LLM引导的迭代图遍历策略，能够有效提升复杂条件性问答的推理能力和回答准确性；该方法的软件流水线已公开释出。

Abstract: Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks.
  To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations.
  We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.

</details>


### [100] [Comparing British and American Audio Description of Movies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09792)
*Igor Sterner,Alex Lascarides,Frank Keller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文比较了英国与美国音频描述（audio description）之间的差异，基于两地指南和从业人员意见提出假设，并在206部电影的双语料库上进行定量验证，证实了词汇、语法结构、命名方式、场景提示及与对话/音乐重叠程度等多方面的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频描述是为盲人和视障人士叙述电影视觉内容的叙事技术，但其约束远多于一般叙述——需嵌入对话间隙且必须符合各地区的指南规范。目前缺乏对美国和英国音频描述之间系统性差异的定量研究，作者希望通过数据驱动的方式揭示这些区域性差异。

Method: 作者首先依据英、美两地的音频描述撰写指南和从业者的实践经验提出具体假设，然后利用一个包含206部电影、每部同时有人类撰写的美国版和英国版音频描述的语料库，对这些假设进行定量检验。

Result: 所有假设均获得定量证据支持，包括：词汇选择、进行体（progressive aspect）的使用、被动结构的使用、主观形容词和修饰语的使用、角色命名时机、场景提示方式，以及与对白和音乐的重叠程度等方面，英美之间均存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 该研究为音频描述这一叙事技术提供了定量分析视角，揭示了区域指南对实际创作实践的显着影响，有助于深化对音频描述规范及其文化差异的理解。

Abstract: Narrating the visual component of movies is known as audio description. It is a narrative technique designed to enable blind and visually impaired individuals to follow the story. However, it is far more constrained than most narratives: the descriptions not only need to convey the story in the movie, but they must also fit into gaps between dialogue and they need to conform to guidelines that exist in each region. In this work, we compare audio description created in the United Kingdom against audio description created in the United States. We use guidelines written for these two regions, alongside the impressions from a practitioner in the field, to motivate specific hypotheses about the differences. We test these hypotheses against our pre-existing corpus, which provides both human-authored American and British audio description for each of 206 movies. Results provide quantitative evidence to uphold all tested hypotheses, including differences in lexicon, the use of the progressive aspect, the use of passive constructions, the use of subjective adjectives and modifiers, when characters are named, how scenes are cued, and degree of overlap with movie dialogue and music. Our work offers a quantitative lens into the narrative technique of audio description.

</details>


### [101] [SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09802)
*Yuling Shi,Jinghan Xu,Kelin Fu,Wenhao Zeng,Shilin He,Lei Zhang,Yue Liu,Zelin Zhao,Terry Yue Zhuo,Jialun Cao,Siyu Ye,Tianyu Liu,Kai Cai,Shing-Chi Cheung,Xiaodong Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SWE-Bench ProMax，一个专家策划的多语言代码重构基准，包含170个来自七个编程语言真实提交的实例，平均跨越11.4个文件和261.6行代码。通过多阶段严格筛选（重写问题描述、人工审查测试套件、过滤低复杂度任务），解决了现有基准中近60%未解决实例存在的测试缺陷问题。实验表明最先进的AI编码代理仅达到41.2%的解决率，证实该基准对当前模型构成有意义的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI编码代理基准（如SWE-bench Verified）正在迅速饱和，且存在严重的质量问题：审计发现近60%未解决实例包含有缺陷的测试（要么过于狭窄拒绝正确解，要么过于宽泛检查未明确要求），前沿模型甚至可以从训练数据中逐字复现gold patch。代码重构任务要求跨多文件的协调行为保持更改，是更具挑战性和现实性的代理能力测试，但现有基准对此覆盖不足。

Method: 构建SWE-Bench ProMax：从七个编程语言（Python、Java、TypeScript、Go、C、C++、Rust）的真实提交中精选170个重构实例。采用多阶段严格策划流程：(1)从头重写问题描述以提供精确、无歧义的规格；(2)人工审查测试套件，移除过于狭窄和过于宽泛的测试；(3)过滤复杂度不足或跨文件范围有限的实例。最终基准平均每实例涉及11.4个修改文件和261.6行代码。使用两种agent脚手架评估前沿模型。

Result: 在最先进的模型和两种agent框架下，最佳模型仅达到41.2%的解决率，显著低于现有基准的饱和水平。鉴于实例规模和任务复杂度远超过现有基准（平均11.4个文件和261.6行代码），SWE-Bench ProMax确实构成了当前AI编码代理尚未饱和的有意义挑战。

Conclusion: SWE-Bench ProMax通过严格的质量控制和聚焦代码重构这一高难度任务，提供了一个未饱和、更真实的基准来评估AI编码代理能力。该基准已公开在HuggingFace上，可供研究社区使用，有望推动AI编码代理在复杂、长周期软件工程任务上的进步。

Abstract: As AI coding agents take on increasingly complex, long-horizon software engineering tasks, existing benchmarks are rapidly saturating and their evaluation quality has come under serious scrutiny: a recent audit found that nearly 60% of unsolved SWE-bench Verified instances contain flawed tests -- either overly narrow tests that reject correct solutions or overly broad tests that check unstated requirements -- and that frontier models can verbatim reproduce gold patches from training data. Code refactoring, which requires coordinated, behavior-preserving changes across many files, offers a substantially harder and more realistic test of agent capability, yet remains underserved by current benchmarks. We introduce SWE-Bench ProMax, an expert-curated, multilingual code refactoring benchmark of 170 instances drawn from real commits across seven programming languages (Python, Java, TypeScript, Go, C, C++, and Rust). Every instance undergoes rigorous, multi-stage curation that directly addresses the quality problems identified in prior benchmarks: issue descriptions are rewritten from scratch to provide precise, unambiguous specifications, and test suites are manually reviewed to remove overly narrow and overly broad tests. Tasks with insufficient complexity or limited cross-file scope are filtered out, yielding a benchmark of challenging, large-scale refactoring tasks that average 11.4 modified files and 261.6 lines of code per instance, substantially exceeding the scale of existing benchmarks. Experiments with frontier models under two agent scaffolds show that the best model achieves only 41.2% resolve rate, confirming that SWE-Bench ProMax presents a meaningful and unsaturated challenge for current AI coding agents. Our benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/swe-bench-promax/SWE-Bench-ProMax.

</details>


### [102] [RA-FinBERT: Rule-aware LoRA adaptation for low-resource financial sentiment classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09834)
*Fan Zhang,Jiaming Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RA-FinBERT，一种参数高效的金融情感分析框架，将LoRA微调的FinBERT与VADER规则派生的连续情感特征及元数据特征相结合，仅增加1,024个可训练权重即在测试集上达到69.89%的准确率，显著优于纯文本FinBERT基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有资源高效的金融NLP研究主要集中于压缩或适配预训练语言模型，较少关注将上下文表示与轻量级规则派生特征相结合。作者旨在探索在有限计算资源下，通过融合规则情感信号与上下文表示来提升金融情感分类性能。

Method: 构建四维标准化特征向量（VADER派生的正、负、中性情感比例及来源元数据特征），将其与FinBERT最终层768维[CLS]表示直接拼接，通过轻量级分类头进行分类。采用LoRA低秩适配实现参数高效微调，仅引入额外1,024个可训练权重。

Result: 在金融新闻标题与描述的三种情感分类任务上，RA-FinBERT达到69.89%准确率和0.634的宏F1分数，优于纯文本FinBERT的63.44%和0.526。中性类别召回率从18.18%提升至45.45%。支持CPU和GPU执行。

Conclusion: 规则派生的情感信息与来源元数据能为FinBERT上下文表示提供互补信号，以极小模型复杂度显著提升金融情感分类性能，在计算资源受限环境下具有实用价值。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis converts unstructured financial news into quantitative signals that can support market analysis and decision-making. Existing work on resource-efficient financial NLP has largely focused on compressing or adapting pretrained language models, with less attention to combining contextual representations with lightweight rule-derived features. This study develops Rule-Aware FinBERT (RA-FinBERT), a parameter-efficient framework that integrates low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with three continuous VADER-derived sentiment proportions (positive, negative, and neutral) and a source-level metadata feature. The standardized four-dimensional feature vector is directly concatenated with the 768-dimensional final-layer FinBERT [CLS] representation and passed through a lightweight classification head. This design introduces only 1,024 additional trainable weights relative to a structurally matched text-only FinBERT model. RA-FinBERT was evaluated against text-only FinBERT and a lightweight DistilBERT baseline for three-class sentiment classification of financial-news titles and descriptions. On the held-out test set, RA-FinBERT achieved 69.89% accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.634, compared with 63.44% and 0.526 for text-only FinBERT. Neutral-class recall increased from 18.18% to 45.45%. The framework supports both CPU and GPU execution, offering a lightweight and practical approach to financial sentiment classification under constrained computational resources. These findings indicate that rule-derived sentiment information and source metadata can provide complementary signals to contextual FinBERT representations and improve performance with minimal additional model complexity.

</details>


### [103] [Fusion Training for Mathematical Generalization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09893)
*Congfeng Cao,Pengyu Zhang,Jelke Bloem*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了Thinking Mode Fusion（TMF）中思考和思考两种模式之间的训练动力学，重点分析了数据比例和训练调度的影响，发现两种模式存在非对称交互与负相关，并提供了实用的训练设置建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TMF允许单一LLM同时支持简洁回答和长链推理，但其训练动力学（数据比例和训练调度）尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统性指导。

Method: 以数学问题求解为焦点，构建了包含多种思考/非思考数据比例和三种训练调度的基准测试，系统分析训练调度和数据比例对TMF的影响。

Result: 发现两种模式存在非对称交互：增加非思考监督比例会降低思考模式的准确性；不同训练调度会调节这一权衡，且最优调度取决于数据比例；量化了非思考与思考模式监督之间的负相关。

Conclusion: 揭示了思考与非思考模式之间的固有张力，为设计有效的TMF训练设置提供了实用指导，并公开了代码和数据。

Abstract: Thinking Mode Fusion (TMF) enables large language models to support both concise responses and long-form reasoning by unifying a non-thinking mode and a thinking mode within a single model. However, its training dynamics, including the \emph{data ratio} and \emph{training schedule} between the two modes, remain underexplored. In this work, we present a systematic study of TMF by analyzing the effects of the training schedule and data ratio between thinking and non-thinking modes. Focusing on mathematical problem solving, we construct a benchmark with multiple thinking-to-non-thinking data ratios and three training schedules. Our results reveal an asymmetric interaction between the two modes: increasing the ratio of non-thinking supervision reduces the accuracy of the thinking mode. We further show that different training schedules modulate this trade-off and that the optimal schedule depends on the data ratio. Finally, we quantify a negative correlation between non-thinking and thinking mode supervision, highlighting an inherent tension between these two modes. These findings provide practical guidance for designing effective TMF training settings. All code and data are released to support further research at: \href{https://github.com/caocongfeng/Fusion-Bench.git}{\textbf{Fusion Bench}}.

</details>


### [104] [Consilience for Verifier-Free Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09898)
*Lecheng Kong,Like Hui,Haitao Mao,Jun Huan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出现有基于置信度的无验证器测试时缩放（VF-TTS）方法在复杂任务上会灾难性失效，并提出consilience框架，通过评估推理过程中置信度的时序不对称性来优化选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无验证器测试时缩放（VF-TTS）在无法获取外部验证器的真实应用中至关重要，其中基于置信度的方法因其低开销和高灵活性而受到关注。然而现有方法在复杂任务上会灾难性失效，表现为均匀高置信度往往意味着探索失败，容易偏向有把握但错误的答案。

Method: 提出consilience选择框架，核心洞察是稳健的认知搜索需要特定的置信度轨迹模式：初始低置信度进行探索性分支，最终收敛到高置信度解。通过组合度量显式惩罚高初始置信度并严格要求最终确定性，从而评估推理过程中置信度的时序不对称性。

Result: 在研究生级别数学问题和自由形式代码生成两类任务上的广泛实验表明，consilience显著优于现有基线，验证了基于完成置信度的新视角的有效性。

Conclusion: 置信度轨迹的动态模式而非单纯最终置信度水平是评估rollout质量的关键信号，consilience通过对置信度时序不对称性的显式建模有效解决了现有VF-TTS方法的局限。

Abstract: Test-time scaling often uses an external verifier, such as compilers and test cases in coding or trained value functions in robotics applications, to obtain high-quality rollouts. Verifier-free test-time scaling (or VF-TTS) is gaining extensive attention as a mechanism to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, primarily because we do not have access to such high-quality verifiers in many real-world applications. Among existing VF-TTS methods, confidence-based VF-TTS methods, which compute and rank rollouts solely by confidence, are particularly promising. Such methods introduce near-zero overhead for sample evaluation and require minimal access to internal model states, making the methods highly flexible across models and tasks.
  In this paper, we demonstrate a critical limitation of existing confidence-based VF-TTS methods by showing that such methods catastrophically break down on complex tasks. We observe a very interesting phenomenon: uniformly high confidence frequently indicates a failure to explore, favoring confidently wrong answers. To address this, our core insight is that robust cognitive search requires a specific confidence trajectory pattern: such methods perform exploratory branching at the beginning, as manifested by low initial confidence, and converge to a high final confidence solution. To implement this insight, we introduce consilience, a novel selection framework that explicitly evaluates the temporal asymmetry of confidence in reasoning. We operationalize this via a combinatorial metric that actively penalizes high initial confidence while strictly demanding final certainty. Extensive experiments covering both graduate-level mathematics problems and free-form code generation demonstrate that consilience effectively outperforms existing baselines, validating our novel perspective on completion confidence.

</details>


### [105] [Decoding-Level Taboo: A Diagnostic Stress Test for LLM Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09900)
*Tadanobu Chuyo Kamijo,Ori Rottenstreich,Javier Conde,Gonzalo Martínez,Pedro Reviriego*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Decoding-Level Taboo，一种零提示的诊断性压力测试方法，通过在运行时直接干预logit空间、动态屏蔽主候选词来迫使模型偏离其最优生成路径，从而评估LLM在非标称条件下的鲁棒性。实验发现，越轨鲁棒性受参数规模和指令对齐显著影响，两者通常都能提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估通常只在标称条件下进行性能测试，掩盖了模型能力的真实上限——模型只在狭窄的、被高度优化的生成通道上表现良好。然而在真实部署中，复杂的系统提示、安全护栏和结构约束会不断将模型推离这条标称路径，导致基准分数与部署性能之间出现显著偏差。

Method: Taboo是一种零提示（zero-prompt）的诊断性压力测试方法，它在运行时直接在logit空间中干预模型的解码过程，通过动态屏蔽词边界处的主候选token，迫使模型进行迂回表述（circumlocution）。该方法不依赖任何提示构造，直接从解码层面施加约束，从而将模型推离其最舒适、被高度优化的生成路径。

Result: 在多个开源权重模型家族上的评估表明，越轨鲁棒性（off-path robustness）受参数规模和训练后的指令对齐影响显著，模型规模和指令对齐程度越高，其越轨鲁棒性通常越好。

Conclusion: Taboo不仅是一种评估工具，还提供了一种新的原语，可用于生成多样化的合成数据集、对运行时安全护栏进行压力测试，以及在真实部署前审计模型的可靠性。

Abstract: Large language model evaluations typically focus on performance under nominal conditions, creating an illusion of capability where models comfortably walk a narrow, highly optimized generation corridor. In real-world deployments, however, complex system prompts, safety guardrails, and structural constraints continuously force models off this nominal path, driving a divergence between benchmark scores and deployment performance. To address this issue, we introduce Decoding-Level Taboo, a zero-prompt diagnostic stress test that intervenes directly in logit space at runtime, forcing models out of their nominal paths. By dynamically masking primary candidate tokens at word boundaries, Taboo forces machine circumlocution.
  Evaluating Taboo across several open-weight model families reveals that off-path robustness is heavily influenced by both parameter scale and post-training instruction alignment, with robustness generally improving with model size and alignment. Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.

</details>


### [106] [From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09925)
*Laurens Samson,Iva Gornishka,Gossa Lô,Yuki M. Asano,Sennay Ghebreab*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了"Grip on LLMs"框架，这是首个面向荷兰政府使用的LLM系统化评估套件，包含六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本和训练数据透明度），对30多个多语言和荷兰语特定模型进行了基准测试，并发布了一个面向非技术受众的公开模型概览工具。研究发现没有单一模型在所有维度上表现优异，质量与环保/成本之间存在不可避免的权衡，且事实性与诚实性由不同属性决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型正越来越多地部署在政府环境中，但现有评估框架很少同时体现公共行政的价值观和非英语环境的语言要求。缺乏一个系统性、与政府需求对齐的评估工具。

Method: 与荷兰主要市政组织的领域专家合作，通过咨询委员会流程、用户研究和公务员聊天机器人用户调查，识别出六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本和训练数据透明度），并将其操作化为涵盖30多个多语言和荷兰语特定模型的基准测试套件。同时开发了一个面向非技术受众的公开模型概览工具。

Result: 研究发现：没有单一模型在所有维度上均表现优异；质量提升总是伴随更高的环境足迹和财务成本；社会偏见与质量和成本基本无关；事实性（能否答对）与诚实性（能否承认不知道）由不同属性决定，高事实性不代表高诚实性。

Conclusion: 为政府LLM选择提供了实践指导，使从工程师到政策制定者的各类利益相关者都能基于可操作的评估结果做出知情决策，同时揭示了模型评估中不可忽视的权衡关系。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [107] [Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07473)
*Xiang Yin,Tim Miller,Nico Potyka,Antonio Rago,Francesca Toni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将计算论证（computational argumentation）作为评价型人工智能（Evaluative AI, EAI）的形式化计算基础，以实现可解释且可质疑的EAI系统，并为分布式、以人为中心的EAI研究设定长期研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AI系统通常提供单一推荐结果，缺乏对决策的充分支持。EAI作为一种新兴方法，通过呈现竞争性假设及其正反证据来辅助人类决策，但目前缺乏正式的计算基础来保证其可解释性和可争议性（contestability）。

Method: 采用立场论文（position paper）的方法，论证计算论证（computational argumentation）为EAI提供形式化、可计算的理论基础，通过论证框架支持竞争性假设的表示、推理与评估，从而支撑可解释和可质疑的EAI系统设计。

Result: 提出以计算论证作为EAI形式化基石的论点，确立了面向分布式和以人为中心的EAI系统的长期研究议程方向。

Conclusion: 计算论证是适合为可解释、可争议的EAI提供形式化基础的范式，为未来的分布式、人类中心EAI系统研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

</details>


### [108] [Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07474)
*Hiroki Naito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Flow-by-Flow治理范式，解决高损失领域中AI输出速度与人类认知容量不匹配的结构性难题。核心观点是约束条件并非单纯的速度V，而是V×L（每项认知负荷），且AI能力提升只重整负荷结构而非降低总负荷。Flow-by-Flow通过基于形式化可计数特征的成本评分和制度性容量上限，在不评估内容的情况下控制监督负荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明当AI输出速度V超过人类认知容量C_max时，人在环上的监督在结构上不可持续。但作者指出真正的约束是V×L（速度乘以每项认知负荷），而非单纯的V。现有治理机制要么将评估委托给AI（继承幻觉风险），要么委托给人类（面临V×L天花板），均存在根本缺陷，因此需要新的治理范式。

Method: 作者将认知负荷L分解为分诊（triage）、判断（judgment）和响应（response）三个成分，分析其对AI能力改进的不对称响应。在此基础上提出Flow-by-Flow范式，包括：基于形式化可计数特征的认知成本评分（对高产量施加非线性成本），以及将处理量控制在C_max以内的制度性容量上限。推导出四条设计不变量：无内容判断、不可扩展消耗检查者容量、身份绑定逐应用摩擦、无批量放行。并通过蒙特卡罗分析（1000次参数抽样）对比多指标流程控制与单纯监督增强的效果。

Result: 四条设计不变量被证明可联合满足（通过一个参考实现验证），但实际困难被明确承认。蒙特卡罗分析表明，在1000次参数抽样中，复合多指标流程控制在90.8%的试验中优于单纯监督强化。

Conclusion: AI能力提升会重构认知负荷结构（降低判断成本但以省略为代价）而非降低总负荷，因此传统的内容评估式治理不可行。Flow-by-Flow代表一种新的治理方向：绕开内容判断，通过控制流量和制度性容量上限来管理监督负荷，尽管其实践可行性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

</details>


### [109] [Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07476)
*Hai Hai Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论构建规范解释，区分了三种规范化层级（闭包稳定、全局完成、确定性化），将非确定性分类为认知多元性（Type E）和结构多元性（Type S），并提出两种规范化机制（算子式完成和选择式构造），同时将该框架应用于LLM辅助推理中幻觉现象的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多元结构理论中，如何从多个可能的结构解释中构建出规范（canonical）的解释是一个基础性问题。现有工作缺乏一个统一的数学框架来形式化地描述不同层级的规范化过程，也无法精确刻画非确定性的本质来源及其对规范化的影响。

Method: 作者将结构理论建模为T=(Σ, A, I)三元组（签名、公理和推理策略），并定义了可容许解释族。在此基础上区分三种规范化层级：闭包稳定（逐种子收敛）、全局完成（种子无关收敛）和确定性化（唯一可容许解释）。将非确定性分为认知多元性（Epistemic plurality, Type E）和结构多元性（Structural plurality, Type S），其中Type S-strong子类以不存在公共上界为特征。提出算子式完成和选择式构造两种规范化机制，给出其存在的充分结构条件，并证明了纯推理式完成在正性非反演规则和额外可靠性条件下可归约为饱和闭包算子。通过分级算子证明了多层级规范化的结构非交换性，并给出条件分类定理。

Result: 对Type E理论建立了闭包稳定性，而完全确定性化依赖于一个全局合流性质（该性质目前仍开放）。对Type S-strong理论，通过规范选择实现了确定性化。框架还被应用于LLM辅助推理，将幻觉解释为不支持的规范化（unsupported canonicalization）。

Conclusion: 该框架系统性地统一了多元结构理论中的规范化问题，揭示了规范化机制的类型依赖性和结构非交换性，并为理解LLM推理中的幻觉现象提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

</details>


### [110] [Emotion in an active inference model of human driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07480)
*Julian F. Schumann,Johan Engström,Ran Wei,Jens Kober,Martijn Wisse,Arkady Zgonnikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在连续状态空间的主动推断驾驶模型中扩展效价（valence）和唤醒度（arousal）情感表示的新方法，将情感估计同时条件化于当前状态和预测的未来结果，并在两个交互式驾驶场景中验证了情感信号与真实场景中报告的情感模式一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动推断驾驶模型未考虑情感状态对驾驶决策的重要影响。尽管已有工作在非交通领域将情感引入主动推断智能体（基于环状模型中的效价-唤醒度轴），但仅限于离散状态空间的简化设定，无法适用于具有连续状态空间的复杂驾驶模型。

Method: 提出一种扩展的效价与唤醒度公式，可从具有连续状态的复杂主动推断驾驶模型中提取情感信号。关键创新在于：情感估计不仅条件化于当前状态，还条件化于预测的未来结果，从而将时间前瞻性纳入情感建模。

Result: 在两个交互式驾驶场景中评估了所提出的方法，结果显示生成的情感信号与相似场景中报告的真实情感模式相一致。

Conclusion: 该工作将情感维度（效价与唤醒度）成功整合到连续状态空间的主动推断驾驶模型中，为更真实地模拟驾驶员情感驱动的决策行为提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

</details>


### [111] [Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07524)
*Geng Zhang,Xuanlei Zhao,Kai Wang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了Data-Centric Parallel (DCP)方法，通过让数据本身驱动运行时，根据每个批次的序列长度动态调整并行规模、梯度累积和重计算等运行时设置，打破了长序列训练中效率与易用性之间的权衡，在32块H200 GPU上实现最高2.88倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练变长序列的深度学习模型面临显著的计算挑战。现有方法在效率与易用性之间存在艰难权衡：简单方法使用静态配置，导致工作负载不均衡、效率低下；复杂方法则为新模型引入显著的复杂性和大量代码修改。

Method: DCP的核心原则是让数据本身驱动运行时。它根据每个批次(batch)的序列长度，动态调整直接的运行时设置，包括并行规模(parallel size)、梯度累积(gradient accumulation)和重计算(recomputation)等参数。

Result: 在32块H200 GPU上实现了最高2.88倍的加速比。该方法具有良好的泛化能力，仅需10行代码即可集成到任何模型中。

Conclusion: 这种简单而有效的方法有望作为稳健的基线，促进分布式训练中变长序列处理领域的未来发展。

Abstract: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

</details>


### [112] [The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07528)
*Jyotin Goel,Ipshita Bandyopadhyay,Justin Shenk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现语言模型中的线性探针虽然能以近完美精度检测到上下文损坏，但这种检测能力并不能可靠地转化为最终答案正确性的预测能力，形成"知道但不说"的分离现象。该模式跨模型家族（包括推理模型）普遍存在，且探针干预作为实时监控手段的效果高度依赖模型和错误类型，没有单一干预方法占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针在检测语言模型上下文损坏方面表现出近完美的准确性，但作者质疑这种检测能力是否真的能用于预测模型最终输出的可靠性。在部署监控场景中，能够检测到问题并不等同于能够预测失败，这种潜在的解离关系对监控系统的实际部署策略有直接影响，值得系统验证。

Method: 论文设计了多跳算术链任务，通过预注册的"持久性胜过峰值"假设进行系统验证。对比了探针检测损坏的能力与最终答案正确性预测之间的关联，考察了结构化置信度格式下模型输出的行为，并测试了多种探针干预策略（分支选择branch-and-pick、重新提示reprompt、替换先前上下文replace-prior）在不同模型家族（包括推理模型）上的效果。

Result: 三个关键发现：1）检测损坏的探针在预测最终答案正确性方面不具信息量；2）强制模型使用结构化置信度格式时，输出坍缩为两个值且错误率无法区分；3）探针在多跳间的持久性不能区分正确与错误结果，推翻了预注册假设。作为实时监控手段，branch-and-pick在全部模型上净收益为正且是唯一在Llama-3.1-8B上无破坏作用的干预（4个修复、0个破坏），而reprompt和replace-prior破坏正确轨迹的比率与拯救错误轨迹的比率大致相当。

Conclusion: 探针监控是语言化置信度的必要补充，但没有任何单一干预方法在所有场景占优。实际可部署的方案应该是模型感知和错误类型感知的路由策略，而非一刀切的监控干预。这一"知道但不说"的模式为部署监控提供了重要的设计约束。

Abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

</details>


### [113] [NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07530)
*Yuchen Zhou,Niels Bobet,Maribel Acosta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NL2SHACL-Bench基准套件，用于评估从自然语言到SHACL约束的翻译任务，并测试了四个SOTA大语言模型，发现它们在生成语法正确的SHACL方面表现良好，但在复杂逻辑和结构模式的语义等价性上仍有不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHACL是RDF知识图谱验证的核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要专业技术知识，领域专家难以掌握。将自然语言需求翻译成SHACL（NL2SHACL）可以降低这一门槛，但目前缺乏专门的基准测试，且评估生成的形状需要超越字符串比较的方法，因为语义等价的形状可能在序列化和结构上有所不同。

Method: 提出了NL2SHACL-Bench基准套件，并基于该基准评估了四个最先进的LLM在自然语言到SHACL翻译任务中的表现。

Result: 当前LLM能够高度有效地生成语法有效的SHACL，但在生成复杂逻辑和结构模式的语义等价约束方面仍然存在困难，表明NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL技术的进展提供了有意义的基础。

Conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench是一个有价值的基准工具，能够揭示当前LLM在NL2SHACL任务中的优势和不足，为后续研究和改进提供了可靠的评价基础。

Abstract: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

</details>


### [114] [Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07532)
*Mojtaba Eslami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将智能体选择与通信建模为带任务条件净效用的合作博弈，提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器，通过估计Shapley值预测值得联系的智能体，并给出了子模最大化相关的近似保证和实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多智能体LLM系统中，大多数架构要么预先固定通信结构，要么允许全广播通信。两者都会因token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播而效率低下，因为随着活跃智能体和通信链路数量的增加，这些代价也随之上升。需要一个能够动态、成本感知地选择智能体和通信边的方法。

Method: 将智能体选择与通信建模为合作博弈，定义任务条件净效用U(C|x)=V(C|x)-∑c_i，将联盟级成本与智能体激活成本分离。提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器，扩展模型以优化带每边成本的通信边，使用估计的Shapley值在执行前后预测值得联系的智能体。将问题关联到子模最大化，提供了曲率改进界和1/2近似界的证明。

Result: 在合成实验中，贪心路由达到暴力搜索最优效用的99.5%，平均激活8个智能体中的1.96个，而全广播仅达到38.8%。性能对激活成本和冗余权重稳健，但在子模性严重违背或价值估计有噪声时降至66%。

Conclusion: 该框架区分了Shapley定价、hedonic联盟形成和通信图剪枝等方法，提出了在真实多智能体LLM基准上的评估方向。主路由器仍为启发式方法，证明的两种保证并不直接适用，但提供了理论与实践结合的初步成果。

Abstract: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

</details>


### [115] [MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07533)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，基于蜕变测试原理，利用Prolog逻辑编程语言编码空间认知的蜕变关系，自动生成测试用例评估具身智能体的空间认知能力。在三个具身场景中检测出SOTA多模态大语言模型驱动的智能体共计90,422个空间认知错误，SOTA智能体的空间认知（SC）得分仅为0.44-0.52，远低于人类的0.96。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能体评估存在两大缺陷：手动标注的VQA对劳动密集且标注质量不稳定；高层任务完成指标（如导航/操纵成功率）可能掩盖关键漏洞，使智能体通过次优手段或违规方式完成任务，从而隐藏安全风险和低效问题。空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，亟需一种自动化评估智能体空间认知鲁棒性的方法。

Method: 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，构建MetaSpace框架。从真实执行轨迹中提取时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律定义蜕变关系（MRs），并将这些MRs编码为Prolog可执行规则来自动生成测试用例。若智能体违反这些关系，则判定其空间认知失败。同时引入空间认知（SC）评分来量化性能。

Result: 在三个具身场景中的实证评估表明，MetaSpace成功检测出SOTA MLLM驱动的智能体中的90,422个空间认知错误。所有SOTA智能体的平均SC得分在0.44到0.52之间，显著低于人类基准的0.96。

Conclusion: MetaSpace为具身智能体的空间认知评估提供了一种自动化、可扩展且无需人工标注的范式，揭示了现有SOTA智能体在空间认知方面与人类存在显著差距，为未来具身智能体的安全性、鲁棒性和效率改进提供了重要的评估工具和指导方向。

Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

</details>


### [116] [When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07538)
*Chen Liang,Fasheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在经典供应链议价框架下（买方拥有私有需求信息，卖方不掌握信息），通过13,440次LLM对LLM谈判（基准模型对比）系统审计了9个来自OpenAI、Google和Alibaba的LLM智能体在自主采购中的表现。研究发现三个关键维度：能力决定价值创造与可靠性（高达成率98.9%、捕获95.4%首优剩余，但延迟侵蚀21-34%剩余）；剩余分配具有"关系性"（供应商身份比能力排名更能预测分配，不同供应商自博弈买方份额差异达30个百分点）；提示词是战略性杠杆（委托人经济耐心与代理提示策略耐心的分离是最强分配驱动因素，解释90%变异）。文章据此建立了以完美贝叶斯均衡为参照的三维审计框架：折现效率、分配特征、运营可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
