Method: 作者构建了MathShikkha，一个使用GPT-5.4生成推理过程的孟加拉语数学推理数据集。在匹配协议下微调四个4B-7B学生模型，即仅答案（answer-only）和思维链（CoT）两种微调条件共享数据划分、仅响应部分损失掩码、解码和评分设置，唯一区别是训练目标。评估采用域内测试、更大规模的BanglaMATH基准（经过污染审计）以及人类研究（两位共同作者标注员、外部专家裁决、Cohen's κ=0.76-1.00），使用配对bootstrap置信区间和精确McNemar检验进行统计验证。

Result: 在域内测试中，CoT对三个较强骨干（4B之外）无显著增量收益（配对bootstrap 95%置信区间包含零，精确McNemar p≥0.17），尽管生成token数多15-52倍；但CoT显著提升较弱的4B模型18.56点（p<0.0001）。在更大规模的BanglaMATH基准上，CoT对所有四个模型均显著优于仅答案监督，提升幅度为20.1-28.1点（全部p<0.0001）。仅答案微调导致三个模型的域外准确率降至基线模型以下，而CoT对所有四个模型保持或提升了域外表现。人类研究未发现CoT相对于基线的显著推理内容改进，但其可测量的效应是目标语言遵从性和产生可检查的推理过程。

Conclusion: 推理监督（CoT）的价值取决于骨干模型能力和分布偏移情况。在本研究设置下，CoT的主要益处是孟加拉语遵从性、可审计的推理过程以及域外鲁棒性，而非改善域内推理的有效性。这表明在低资源语言场景中，CoT监督的选择应考虑模型能力水平和评估任务的实际分布。

Abstract: Mathematical reasoning remains challenging in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We study whether teacher-generated Bangla Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision provides benefits beyond ordinary supervised fine-tuning. We construct \textsc{MathShikkha}, a Bangla mathematical reasoning dataset with GPT-5.4-generated rationales, and fine-tune four 4B--7B student models under a matched protocol in which answer-only and CoT conditions share data splits, response-only loss masking, decoding, and scoring, differing only in the training target. In-domain, CoT provides no significant improvement over answer-only fine-tuning for three stronger backbones (paired bootstrap 95\% CIs include zero; exact McNemar $p \geq 0.17$), despite generating 15--52$\times$ more tokens, but significantly improves the weaker 4B model by 18.56 points ($p < 0.0001$). On the larger, contamination-audited BanglaMATH benchmark, this pattern reverses: CoT significantly outperforms answer-only supervision for all four models by 20.1--28.1 points (all $p < 0.0001$). Answer-only fine-tuning also reduces out-of-domain accuracy below the base model for three models, whereas CoT preserves or improves it for all four. A human study with two co-author annotators, external-expert adjudication, and Cohen's $κ= 0.76$--$1.00$ finds no significant CoT improvement over the base model on reasoning-content criteria; instead, its measurable effect is target-language adherence and producing inspectable reasoning. Overall, rationale supervision's value depends on backbone capability and distribution shift: in this setting, its main benefits are Bangla adherence, auditable reasoning, and out-of-domain robustness rather than improved in-domain reasoning validity.

</details>


### [215] [Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08506)
*Mohanad Odema,Gabrielle De Micheli,Dayin Gou,Nilesh Malpeddi,Prathamesh Vaste,Jacob Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的LLM低秩压缩框架改进方法，针对现有框架的两个局限（逐层压缩时校准误差累积导致压缩时模拟表示与推理时不一致，以及压缩后层重要性分布保持假设不成立），通过逐层压缩校准修正和迭代压缩秩分配修正来缓解对齐问题，在Llama和Qwen3上相比基线提升约1-2.5个准确率点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最先进的无需训练的低秩压缩框架存在两个关键局限：(1) 压缩过程中校准数据激活值的残差误差跨层累积，导致压缩时模拟的表示与推理时实际经历不一致；(2) 假设压缩后层重要性分布保持不变，但该假设在实际中不成立。这两个问题使压缩过程与部署后的模型之间存在对齐偏差，影响压缩质量。

Method: 提出两个简单且无需训练的修正组件：(1) 逐层压缩与校准修正（Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction），在压缩每一层时对校准数据的激活值进行修正以消除误差累积；(2) 迭代压缩与秩分配修正（Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction），迭代地修正各层秩分配以适应压缩后的实际层重要性分布。该方法可兼容现有的SOTA分解框架。

Result: 将该方法实现在现有SOTA分解框架之上，在Llama和Qwen3模型上的多种基准和压缩率下进行评估，在零样本任务上相比逐权重和联合分解基线实现了约1-2.5个准确率点的提升。

Conclusion: 通过识别并修正压缩过程中残差误差累积和层重要性分布偏移这两个核心对齐问题，本文提出的简单训练免费方法能有效提升低秩压缩框架的压缩质量，且无需额外训练开销，可广泛应用于现有压缩框架。

Abstract: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importance distribution is preserved post-compression does not hold. Together, these two effects introduce misalignment in the compression process in relation to the deployed model. We study these effects and propose a simple, training-free methodology compatible with existing frameworks to mitigate them, comprising: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework, and evaluated on Llama and Qwen3 models across various benchmarks and compression rates, our approach demonstrates up to ~1-2.5 accuracy point improvements over per-weight and joint decomposition baselines on zero-shot tasks.

</details>


### [216] [Time Present and Time Past: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Temporally Evolving Document Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08512)
*Mahbub E Sobhani,Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi,Fahmid Hasan Chowdhury,Md Adnan Arefeen,Farig Sadeque,Md. Faizul Bari,Swakkhar Shatabda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TIDE，一个专家验证的时序版本解析问答基准，包含3,050个问答对，覆盖1969至2025年间孟加拉国政府发布的644份官方海关文书中八种任务类型。评估九个近期LLM后发现，最佳宏平均准确率仅68.5%，版本解析准确率59.7%，拒绝不正确版本的任务仅26.7%，模型倾向于遵循参数化记忆而非提供的权威文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序QA数据集仅将时间视为标注，使版本解析（即识别查询日期对应的有效版本）这一核心挑战未被测试。随着法律、税法、软件文档等文档的不断修订、替换和回退，同一个问题在不同日期有不同正确答案，需要专门的基准来评估模型处理版本解析的能力。

Method: 构建TIDE基准：3,050个专家验证的问答对，覆盖644份官方海关文书（1969-2025），包括八种任务类型，文档深度混合编码（code-mixed），布局异构且使用双历法。评估协议统一：在参数访问、金上下文和检索访问三种模式下评估九个近期LLM，使用三法官LLM委员会评分，并设置硬性日期门控以区分语义正确性与时间正确性。

Result: 最佳宏平均准确率仅68.5%；从隐含日期解析版本的准确率为59.7%；检测所提供版本不适用于查询任务仅26.7%。模型更倾向于找到正确版本而非拒绝错误版本，且倾向于遵循自信的参数化答案而非提供的权威文本。

Conclusion: TIDE揭示了当前LLM在版本解析任务上的显著不足，特别是在拒绝错误版本和从隐含日期推断版本方面。模型在时序版本解析上仍远未达到可靠水平，且存在过度依赖参数记忆而非权威文本的倾向，亟需改进。

Abstract: Evolving documents, such as laws, tax codes, and software documentation, are amended, replaced, and sometimes reverted over time, so a question has different correct answers at different dates. In contrast to encyclopedic knowledge, where an old fact is simply overwritten, an amendment is itself an official text that states what it replaces and when it takes effect, and the earlier version stays correct for its validity period. The central challenge is therefore version resolution, that is, identifying the version in force on the queried date. Existing temporal QA datasets treat time only as an annotation, so version resolution stays untested. We present TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over 644 official customs instruments issued between 1969 and 2025 by the Government of Bangladesh, covering eight task types over deeply code-mixed documents that are heterogeneous in layout and dated in two calendars. In addition, we evaluate nine recent LLMs under a single protocol across parametric, gold-context, and retrieval access, scored by a three-judge LLM council with a hard date gate separating correct meaning from correct time. The best macro-averaged accuracy is only 68.5%. Resolving a version from an implicit date reaches 59.7%, and detecting that the supplied version does not govern the query reaches only 26.7%. Models are more likely to find correct versions than to reject incorrect ones, and they tend to follow a confident parametric answer over the supplied authoritative text. All code and data are available at https://github.com/icsetepa44/TIDE

</details>


### [217] [Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08514)
*Minhan Cho,Jimin Kweon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文独立复现了两种提升LLM推理可靠性的方法（RPC和LCF），并在跨域、跨模型条件下进行压力测试。结果表明：RPC在作者发布的推理路径上能精确复现原结果，但在四个新域上相对自洽性的优势均不显著；LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但微弱，且其在多数模型上无显著正面效果甚至产生负面影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两种方法的原始评估均由各自作者自行完成，从未被第三方独立复现或跨模型、跨域压力测试，且LCF未公开代码。验证这些可靠性声明至关重要，因为缺乏独立验证可能导致方法有效性的过度承诺。

Method: 作者对RPC采用作者发布的推理路径重新运行其聚合管线；对LCF则重新实现了其投影器、对比学习和干预流程。随后将两种方法扩展到四个新任务域（text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别、先例评级），并直接探测LCF的表示空间。

Result: RPC在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现了原始结果网格，但在四个新域上相对自洽性优势从未显著（配对p≥0.28）；在BIRD上其优势随K增长但扩大样本后由+2.5反转为-0.25。LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但微弱（0.82可分性，低于语义属性对照的0.95）；其唯一正面效果不显著（p=0.56），且在另外三个模型中的两个显著降低了ΔProb。

Conclusion: 独立复现发现两种方法的原始可靠性声明均难以泛化：RPC的优势在新域上不稳健且受样本量影响，LCF的效果在跨模型扩展时不稳定甚至产生负效应。这凸显了对LLM可靠性方法进行独立、跨域验证的必要性。

Abstract: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.

</details>


### [218] [Discovering Diverse Planning Policies for Multimodal Embodied Agents with Quality-Diversity Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08523)
*Pengfei Xu,Yong Liu,Xiaoya Nan,Qiang Yang,Peilan Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于质量-多样性（QD）框架的多模态具身智能体规划策略发现方法。该方法将规划策略模板作为可进化个体，离线阶段通过轨迹经验（成功与失败）引导策略变异与重组，构建以交互强度和目标导向性为行为度量的策略档案库；在线阶段检测到持续停滞时回滚检查点并切换到行为上不同的策略继续执行。在ThreeDWorld基准上验证了该方法在任务成功率和交互效率上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于大模型的多模态具身智能体规划器在任务执行过程中往往依赖单一主导的规划风格，一旦该模式失效，智能体可能陷入长时间停滞，反复与环境交互却无法取得实质进展。

Method: 提出QD（质量-多样性）框架：1）将规划策略模板视为可进化个体，组织成行为索引档案库而非坍缩为单一提示风格；2）离线阶段将轨迹总结为结构化成功/失败经验，通过重组和经验引导变异驱动策略多样化；3）策略映射到由交互强度和目标导向性定义的行为空间，每个生态位保留质量最高的策略；4）在线阶段逐策略执行并监控任务进度，检测到持续停滞时回滚到最近检查点并切换行为不同的档案策略。

Result: 在ThreeDWorld运输基准上，所提框架相比代表性基线规划器在任务成功率和交互效率上均有提升。

Conclusion: 发现多样化的策略储备库是支持自适应多模态规划与在线故障恢复的有效途径。

Abstract: Multimodal embodied agents are increasingly required to solve long-horizon tasks by integrating visual observations, textual goals, and interaction history into closed-loop decision making. However, state-of-the-art large-model-based planners often rely on a single dominant planning style during execution. Once this execution mode becomes ineffective, the agent may remain stalled for many steps, repeatedly interacting with the environment without making meaningful progress. We address this limitation by proposing a Quality-Diversity (QD) framework for discovering diverse planning policies for multimodal embodied agents. The proposed method treats planning-policy templates as evolvable individuals and organizes them into a behavior-indexed archive rather than collapsing search to a single prompt style. In the offline stage, rollout trajectories are summarized into structured success and failure experiences, which guide policy variation through recombination and experience-guided mutation. The resulting policies are mapped into a behavior space defined by interaction intensity and goal-directedness, and the highest-quality policy in each niche is retained in the archive. In the online stage, the agent executes one policy at a time while monitoring task progress. When persistent stall is detected, the system rolls back to the latest checkpoint and switches to a behaviorally distinct archive policy to resume execution. Experiments on the ThreeDWorld transport benchmark show that the proposed framework improves both task success and interaction efficiency over representative baseline planners. These results suggest that discovering diverse policy repertoires is an effective way to support adaptive multimodal planning and online failure recovery.

</details>


### [219] [Deep probabilistic logic programming for diagnostic reasoning from incomplete information: A case study in stroke detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08561)
*Felix Weitkämper,Monchito Avila,Elizabeth Nanjala,Siska,Grace Zawadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了如何将文献中的汇总统计数据转化为基于DeepProbLog的神经符号诊断系统，以脑卒中检测为案例研究，利用最大熵技术补全概率信息，并分析了ProbLog 2和ProbFOIL 2在模型构建与压缩中的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学应用中原始数据常涉及隐私问题，因此从文献中编码汇总统计数据具有重要意义。同时，深度学习在基于视觉或听觉传感器数据的症状评估中已成为宝贵工具，需要一种既透明又严格的推理框架来处理医学诊断任务。

Method: 采用DeepProbLog的神经符号方法，结合概率逻辑编程（分布语义下的概率逻辑编程）处理多模态数据中的脑卒中检测。工作流程包括：利用最大熵技术补全文献中不完整的概率信息；使用ProbLog 2从熵最大化的因果模型过渡到可在DeepProbLog中表达的判别性神经符号模型；并利用概率归纳逻辑编程系统ProbFOIL 2对大判别模型进行压缩。

Result: 分析了基于不完整数据的模型相对性能，探讨了ProbFOIL 2压缩大型判别模型的潜力，并对使用DeepProbLog进行诊断推理的视角与含义进行了讨论。

Conclusion: 本文展示了从文献汇总统计数据到可用的神经符号诊断系统的可行路径，DeepProbLog为医学诊断提供了一个透明且严格概率框架下的可扩展方案，同时指出了该方法的前景与局限。

Abstract: In medical applications, raw data is frequently associated with significant privacy concerns, lending particular importance to the encoding of summary statistics from the literature. On the other hand, deep learning has become an invaluable tool for assessing symptoms based on visual or auditory sensor data. DeepProbLog allows for an extensible neuro-symbolic approach that accommodates connectionist components to analyse patient images within a transparent and rigorous probabilistic framework, namely probabilistic logic programming under the distribution semantics. Framed as a case study in stroke detection from multimodal data, this contribution explores the pathway from summary statistics available in the literature to a DeepProbLog-based diagnostic system. It suggests a workflow using established maximum entropy techniques to complete available probabilistic information and the probabilistic logic programming system ProbLog 2 to move from the entropy-maximising causal model to a discriminative neuro-symbolic model expressible within DeepProbLog. The relative performance of models derived from less complete data is analysed alongside the potential of the probabilistic inductive logic programming system ProbFOIL 2 for compressing large discriminative models, and the perspectives and implications of using DeepProbLog for diagnostic reasoning are discussed.

</details>


### [220] [VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08569)
*Wenxu Jia,Dongjie Fu,Xize Cheng,Fangming Feng,Linjun Li,Wenshi Chen,Yingming Li,Zhou Zhao,Tao Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VoxZip是一种无需训练的、两阶段语义锚定的KV缓存压缩框架，用于解决语音大语言模型长上下文推理中KV缓存内存开销过大的瓶颈问题。在Qwen3-Omni上的六项音频基准测试中，VoxZip在20倍压缩下仍保持超过90%的基线性能，并在4倍压缩时实现1.9倍推理吞吐量提升和3.3倍峰值内存减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管语音大语言模型在复杂音频任务上展现了强大的理解能力，但其长上下文推理受限于巨大的KV缓存内存需求。现有的文本中心压缩方法在语音场景下往往破坏语音连续性或丢失关键语义信息，亟需针对语音模态特性的KV缓存压缩方案。

Method: VoxZip采用两阶段无需训练（train-free）的压缩框架：第一阶段利用ASR转录文本作为显式语义锚点，对音频token进行时间对齐、压缩和融合，显著减少初始KV缓存并提升token信息密度；第二阶段基于时间衰减的累积注意力实现动态过滤策略，驱逐非必要token并缓解早期token偏差问题。

Result: 在Qwen3-Omni上的六种音频基准测试中，VoxZip在长音频推理任务中表现优异，同时保持短时任务的高保真感知。在20倍激进KV缓存压缩下仍保持超过90%的未压缩基线性能；在4倍压缩比下实现1.9倍推理吞吐量提升和3.3倍峰值内存开销降低。

Conclusion: VoxZip通过语义锚定的两阶段压缩策略，有效解决了语音LLM长上下文推理中的KV缓存瓶颈，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著提升了压缩比和推理效率，为语音大模型的实用化部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The first stage uses automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcriptions as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, significantly reducing the initial KV cache while elevating token information density. To further improve the compression ratio, the second stage employs a dynamic filtering strategy based on temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict non-essential tokens while mitigating early-token bias. Comprehensive evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six diverse audio benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. VoxZip excels in long-audio reasoning and consistently maintains high-fidelity perception on short-form tasks. Notably, it sustains over 90\% of the uncompressed baseline performance even under an aggressive 20x KV cache compression in long-context scenarios. Furthermore, at a 4x compression ratio, VoxZip yields a 1.9x increase in inference throughput alongside a 3.3x reduction in peak memory overhead. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxZip.

</details>


### [221] [FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08570)
*Dongyi Lv,Fushun E,Aichen Cai,Liang Huang,Ya Zhang,Qiuyu Ding,Canhui Wu,Zhi Wang,Yuesong Zhang,Jiaqi Wang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FailForge是一个智能体框架，将拒绝采样微调（RFT）中失败的轨迹转化为训练信号。对于每个失败的实例，它让智能体诊断失败原因、提炼为可操作的技能，并在技能引导下进行第二次尝试；成功的轨迹被重新纳入RFT语料库，但训练时去除技能提示，使模型将行为内化而不过度依赖外部提示。在SWE-bench Verified上提升了6.6个百分点的解决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RFT在微调代码智能体时直接丢弃失败的轨迹，但这些失败的样本恰恰是最困难、信息量最大的，且来自昂贵的可验证实例。尽管更强的基座模型可以减少失败，但剩余的困难案例仍然定义了进一步改进的前沿。因此需要一种方法将这些被丢弃的"最难样本"转化为有效的训练信号。

Method: FailForge包含三个核心步骤：（1）失败诊断——由一个智能体从错误反馈和执行轨迹中诊断每个失败实例的根本原因；（2）技能提炼——将诊断结果蒸馏为简洁可操作的技能描述；（3）引导式重试——将技能注入智能体上下文进行第二次尝试。成功的轨迹被折叠回RFT语料库。关键设计是训练时将技能移除，确保模型内化所学行为而非依赖推理时的外部提示。

Result: FailForge以边际额外成本恢复了超过26%之前失败的任务实例。使用增强后的语料库训练Qwen3.5-4B，在SWE-bench Verified上相比强RFT基线提升了6.6个百分点的解决率，且增益集中在最困难的问题上。

Conclusion: 通过将失败的rollout转化为可重复使用的训练信号，FailForge证明了被标准RFT丢弃的"最难样本"是宝贵的训练资源，能够显著提升代码智能体在困难任务上的表现，且成本可控。

Abstract: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stronger base models may reduce the number of failures, but the remaining hard cases still define the frontier for further improvement. We propose FailForge, an agentic framework that converts failed rollouts into training signal. For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise and actionable skill, and injects the skill into the agent context for a guided second attempt. Trajectories that succeed under skill guidance are folded back into the RFT corpus. Crucially, the skill is removed at training time, so the model internalizes the recovered behavior rather than relying on external hints at inference. FailForge recovers over 26% of previously failed instances at marginal additional cost, and training Qwen3.5-4B on the augmented corpus improves the SWE-bench Verified resolve rate by 6.6 points over a strong RFT baseline, with gains concentrated on the hardest problems.

</details>


### [222] [SDDBMs: Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08594)
*Shiyi Qi,Kun He,Mingmou Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出软去噪扩散桥模型（SDDBMs），通过在终端约束层面进行正则化（赋予非退化高斯终端边缘分布而非硬性端点约束），解决了现有扩散桥模型因硬端点条件导致的终端边界奇异性和病态漂移系数问题，并提供统一的概率视角涵盖DDBM、GOUB、UniDB等现有模型为特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散桥模型（基于Doob's h-变换构建）依赖硬端点条件约束，迫使终端状态精确匹配目标分布，导致终端定律退化为Dirac测度，使漂移系数在端点附近病态（ill-conditioned），产生终端边界奇异性，影响数值稳定性和生成质量。

Method: SDDBMs在变换路径测度下规定非退化的高斯终端边缘分布（具有灵活的终端中心和方差），代替硬性精确端点。基于此边缘分布，推导完整的软桥闭式构造，包括：高斯终端重加权、软h函数、诱导的高斯前向边缘分布以及不依赖x0的动力学。该框架通过特定参数选择可还原DDBMs、GOUB和UniDB等现有模型。

Result: 在图像恢复任务上的大量实验表明，SDDBMs相比现有基于桥的方法在数值稳定性和生成质量方面均取得更优表现。

Conclusion: SDDBMs通过软化终端约束提供了一种广义且统一的扩散桥框架，有效缓解硬端点的奇异性问题，同时涵盖了多种现有桥模型作为特例，为扩散桥模型的稳定训练与高质量生成提供了新的理论范式。

Abstract: Diffusion bridge models leverage Doob's \(h\)-transform to construct stochastic transports between arbitrary endpoint distributions, and have shown strong potential in image-to-image translation and restoration. However, most existing bridge models rely on hard endpoint conditioning, which forces the terminal state to match a prescribed target exactly. This hard constraint induces terminal-boundary singularities: the terminal law collapses to a Dirac measure, and the resulting drift coefficients become ill-conditioned near the endpoint. In this paper, we propose Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models (SDDBMs), a generalized framework that regularizes diffusion bridges directly at the level of their terminal constraints. Instead of imposing an exact endpoint, SDDBMs prescribe a non-degenerate Gaussian terminal marginal under the transformed path measure, with a flexible terminal center and variance. Starting from this prescribed marginal, we develop a complete closed-form construction of the soft bridge, including the Gaussian terminal reweighting and soft \(h\)-function, the induced Gaussian forward marginals and \(\mathbf{x}_0\)-free dynamics. Theoretically, SDDBMs provide a unified probabilistic perspective that encompasses existing diffusion bridge models, including DDBMs, GOUB, and UniDB, as special cases under specific parameter choices. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks demonstrate that SDDBMs achieve improved numerical stability and superior generation quality over existing bridge-based methods.

</details>


### [223] [Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08601)
*Gabriele La Malfa,Lakmal Meegahapola,Edyta Bogucka,Jie M. Zhang,Michael Luck,Elizabeth Black,Daniele Quercia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对工作场所AI智能体风险的多层分类框架和15类风险分类法，通过对2,078个O*NET工作任务生成8,356个风险场景，并用4名工人和独立LLM验证，发现增强未必安全、错误智能体行为风险占比最高、自动化主要带来组织风险而增强主要带来工人风险，且该分类法在可用性上优于现有分类法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI风险分类法过于宽泛，无法捕捉AI智能体在工作场所特定岗位上引入的职业特定风险，组织需要针对性的分类框架来预判和应对这些社会技术风险。

Method: 首先通过文献综述构建包含智能体、目标、环境三个核心组件及其交互的多层框架；将该框架嵌入结构化提示词，应用于O*NET数据库2,078个工作任务描述，生成8,356个按严重程度和部署模式（自动化或增强）标注的风险场景；用45名分布在10个职业角色的工人和独立LLM裁判验证场景的合理性与任务对齐；最后扩展现有分类法形成15类工作场所AI智能体风险分类法。

Result: 研究发现四项主要结论：（1）增强模式并非天然安全，过度依赖会侵蚀工人的技能和监督能力；（2）错误智能体行为占风险场景最大比例且严重风险集中度最高，许多人机边界处的风险；（3）自动化主要关联组织层面风险，而增强主要关联工人层面风险；（4）工人认为该分类法比另外两个分类法更易用于风险分类任务，在与近期生成式AI风险分类法的非并列比较中64%被优先选择。

Conclusion: 工作场所AI智能体风险不仅来源于智能体本身，还取决于人们如何与智能体协作以及智能体如何被部署。更安全的工作场所不仅需要更安全的智能体，还需要精心设计的人机协作方式。

Abstract: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.

</details>


### [224] [ForestBench: A Unified Graph Framework for Evaluating Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08605)
*Guo Chen,Ziwen Li,Reed Li,Yu Lu,Haibo Shi,Bingbing Xu,Junjie Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ForestBench，一个基于统一协作图的通用多智能体系统（MAS）评估框架，将异构执行轨迹映射到共享表示空间，通过与查询相关的参考森林比较来评分，无需额外LLM推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统（MAS）快速增长，但其异构执行轨迹缺乏统一的评估基础。现有方法要么只评估最终结果（丢失协作信息），要么依赖LLM作为裁判（需要额外的模型推断且结果不稳定）。需要一个不依赖模型、可复用且能保留协作结构信息的评估框架。

Method: 将原生的MAS执行轨迹映射到统一的协作图空间；候选图与查询特定的参考森林进行比较；参考森林由基准提供的已验证成功图集合构成（每个查询预计算十个成功的目标条件参考图）；涵盖844个需要协作的查询和六个代表性MAS框架；并通过受控骨干、参考构建和扰动研究测试评估的稳定性和范围。

Result: ForestBench在基准森林构建完成后，可以在毫秒内对轨迹进行评分，无需额外的LLM推断，为比较多样化的MAS协作轨迹提供了可复用的结构性基础。

Conclusion: ForestBench提供了一个统一、高效且可复用的MAS评估框架，通过将不同方法的执行轨迹映射到共享的协作图空间并与其参考森林比较，实现了跨方法的公平结构评估，同时避免了结果导向评估的信息丢失和LLM裁判评估的模型依赖性问题。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) are proliferating rapidly, but their heterogeneous execution traces provide no common basis for evaluation across methods. Outcome-only benchmarks discard collaborations, whereas LLM-as-Judge evaluation requires additional, model-dependent inference and can vary with the LLM and rubric. We introduce a generalizable evaluation framework that maps native MAS traces into a shared space of unified collaboration graphs, enabling different methods to be evaluated under the same representation, reference set, and metric panel. Candidate graphs are compared with a query-specific reference forest. Each forest is a benchmark-provided collection of verified-success graphs: it records diverse ways in which representative MAS methods can complete the task, rather than prescribing a unique optimal process. Instantiating the framework as ForestBench, we filter $844$ collaboration-necessary queries from seven public datasets, precompute ten successful target-conditioned reference graphs per query, and evaluate six representative MAS frameworks. Controlled backbone, reference-construction, and perturbation studies test the stability and scope of evaluation. Once the benchmark forests are built, ForestBench scores a trace in milliseconds without further LLM inference, providing a reusable structural basis for comparing diverse MAS collaboration traces.

</details>


### [225] [Walking through Discussions: A Mobile Visual Analytics System for In-Situ Group Discussion Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08617)
*Yiping Sun,Ziyao Kang,Wei Zeng,Minli Wu,Jiazhi Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MobileGroupVis，一个面向物理课堂小组讨论场景的移动端可视化分析系统，支持教师在教室内走动巡视时实时监控多个小组、诊断目标小组并实施教学干预，通过流式音频分析管道和六种协调视图实现可扫视概览与可追溯诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于小组讨论的教学法被广泛采用，但教师在实际课堂中难以同时监控多个小组并快速诊断需要干预的目标小组。现有的可视化分析工具主要支持桌面端的回溯性分析（post-hoc），缺乏对教师在教室内走动式教学（in-situ walk-around）场景的实时支持，存在明显的研究缺口。

Method: MobileGroupVis包含三个核心部分：（1）轻量级流式分析管道，将小组音频实时转换为结构化讨论数据，并通过对话分析模块提取交互模式、话题进展和话题偏离等信息；（2）针对小屏幕触控交互设计的简洁分析工作流，整合多组监控、单组诊断和教学干预三个环节；（3）六个协调视图，包括紧凑字形（编码词数、交互强度和话题偏离）用于跨组比较与异常定位，以及意见演化、交互动态、话题覆盖和对话记录等详细视图。

Result: 通过两个案例研究和专家访谈评估，结果表明MobileGroupVis初步验证了其能有效支持教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组，并促进课内干预的实施。

Conclusion: MobileGroupVis填补了课堂小组讨论可视化分析中移动端原位支持的空白，其"可扫视概览+可追溯诊断"的设计范式为同类实时协作学习分析系统提供了有价值的参考方向。

Abstract: Group discussion-based teaching is widely used to foster collaborative learning, yet teachers in physical classrooms often struggle to simultaneously monitor multiple groups and quickly diagnose a target group before intervening. Existing visual analytics tools primarily support post-hoc analysis on desktop, providing limited support for in-situ walk-around teaching. To address this gap, we present MobileGroupVis, a mobile visual analytics system for in-situ analysis of classroom group discussions. MobileGroupVis integrates multi-group monitoring, single-group diagnosis, and instructional intervention into a concise analytical workflow tailored for small-screen touch interaction. The system is powered by a lightweight streaming analysis pipeline that converts group audio into structured discussion data and further extracts interaction patterns, topic progression, and topic deviation through a dialogue analysis module. To enable both glanceable overview and traceable diagnosis, we design six coordinated views, including a compact glyph that visually encodes word count, interaction intensity, and topic deviation for efficient cross-group comparison and anomaly localization, along with detailed views for opinion evolution, interaction dynamics, topic coverage, and dialogue records. We evaluate MobileGroupVis through two case studies and expert interviews. The results provide preliminary evidence that MobileGroupVis supports teachers in understanding discussion processes, identifying groups in need of attention, and facilitating in-class intervention.

</details>


### [226] [Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08621)
*Yijun Pan,Yukun Lian,Kunyu Shi,Junbo Li,Hongwei Xue,Sicong Xie,Guannan Zhang,Xiaoying Xing*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Business Arena，一个基于真实阿里巴巴采购数据和权威市场校准的受控环境，用于评估AI智能体在长期跨境电商运营中的端到端商业能力。评估了15个前沿模型，发现最终净资产均值存在九倍差异，即使最好的模型也落后于人类设计的策略，表明商业运营对LLM智能体仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM智能体能完成日益复杂的工作流，但现有智能体基准很少评估商业相关能力。企业经营需要从不完整信号中推断机会、在不确定性下投入资本、适应延迟反馈并满足法规要求，这些能力组合在现有基准中缺乏系统评估。

Method: 构建Business Arena受控环境，包含：1) 基于真实Alibaba.com采购数据和权威市场条件校准的跨境电商场景；2) 与人类设计策略对比以估算可用机会；3) 技能级指标揭示潜在优劣势；4) 行动级归因追踪损益来源；5) 机制消融实验排除模拟器捷径和忽视行为的影响。

Result: 评估15个前沿模型，最终净资产均值存在九倍差异；即使最优模型也落后于人类设计策略，证明商业运营对LLM智能体仍然困难。技能级分析揭示了从利润率导向的溢价卖家到高周转批发商和客户服务专家的不同运营风格，行动级归因识别出采购、定价和止损决策中创造或毁灭价值的关键环节。

Conclusion: Business Arena为端到端商业智能体的评估提供了一个现实且可信的测试平台，迈出了该领域的第一步。结果表明LLM在商业运营方面仍有显著提升空间，而技能级和行动级分析为理解智能体行为、指导后续改进提供了细粒度诊断工具。

Abstract: Running a business is a challenging form of intelligent work. Operators must infer opportunities from partial signals, commit capital under uncertainty, adapt to delayed outcomes in a changing market, and satisfy regulatory obligations before trading legally. Frontier LLM agents can increasingly complete complex workflows, yet business-related capabilities are rarely evaluated in existing agent benchmarks. We introduce \textbf{Business Arena}, a controlled environment where an AI agent runs a cross-border shop, buying from suppliers and selling to buyers over a long horizon. We ground the arena in real Alibaba.com sourcing data and market conditions calibrated from authoritative sources. Delayed and coupled consequences make individual business decisions difficult to judge, but their combined outcome is measurable through profit. Because profit alone cannot explain why an agent succeeds or fails, we compare agents with human-designed strategies to estimate available opportunity, use skill-level metrics to reveal underlying strengths and weaknesses, and trace realized gains and losses to the actions that produced them. We use mechanism ablations to establish that strong results reflect genuine business intelligence rather than neglect or simulator-specific shortcuts. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find a ninefold difference in mean final net worth. Even the best model falls behind human-designed strategies, indicating that business operation remains challenging for LLM agents. Skill-level analysis reveals operating styles, from margin-focused premium sellers to high-turnover wholesalers and customer-service specialists, while action-level attribution identifies the sourcing, pricing, and recovery decisions that create or destroy value. Together, Business Arena takes a first step toward a realistic and trustworthy testbed for evaluating end-to-end business agents.

</details>


### [227] [MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08623)
*Haotian Wang,Lian Yan,Xingzhi Yao,Fanshu Meng,Ye He,Jingchi Jiang,Yi Guan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MedCalc-R1，一种知识引导的混合奖励框架，用于解决RLVR框架中基于容差的浮点奖励在数学推理（尤其临床场景）中的校准困难、训练不稳定和精度受限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR框架中，数学推理任务的浮点结果通常采用基于容差的奖励评估，但该方法存在阈值校准困难、训练动力学不稳定、精度受限等问题，尤其在临床安全关键场景中表现不佳。

Method: 提出MedCalc-R1框架：(1) 引入知识验证奖励机制，强制显式生成计算公式并由外部验证器验证，增强可解释性与推理可靠性；(2) 设计混合软硬奖励方案，结合基于临床安全阈值的硬约束和精度敏感的软奖励，在可接受范围内逐步引导学习。

Result: 实验表明该方法在推理准确性和泛化能力上显著优于现有基线，验证了其在安全关键领域的有效性和适用性。

Conclusion: 知识引导的混合奖励框架能有效克服传统容差奖励的局限，在为临床等安全关键场景中的数学推理任务提供更精准、可解释且稳定的评估与学习信号。

Abstract: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.

</details>


### [228] [UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08627)
*Lei Xin,Bin Gu,Peize Li,Zitong Wang,Jianbo Zhao,Changjiang Jiang,Yanyue Xie,Chao Huang,Xuyang Zhao,Zunhai Su,Fanhu Zeng,Zhenglun Kong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniMoMo是一种面向稀疏混合专家（MoE）推荐模型的后训练压缩框架，将专家缩减问题建模为约束图粗化问题，基于功能相似性而非参数距离对专家进行分组合并，并通过层自适应保护机制限制高流量专家的合并。在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec三个数据集上，四专家检查点在保留99.92%-102.30%的NDCG@10性能的同时实现了1.28x-1.63x的A100加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然稀疏MoE层通过条件计算扩展了推荐系统的容量，但训练好的checkpoint仍然存储并路由全部专家。在部署时，需要在明确专家预算下将checkpoint转换为更小的标准MoE，且不能添加压缩专用的在线模块——即需要一种纯后训练、无需额外在线开销的专家缩减方法。

Method: 1) 将专家压缩问题形式化为约束图粗化问题；2) 采用功能相似性而非参数距离来分组专家，使用无标签校准集度量专家对共享推荐状态的响应相似度；3) 引入层自适应保护机制，根据路由曝光度限制高流量专家的合并，防止性能退化；4) 最终在多元数据上验证完整的"转换-适应"工作流。

Result: 在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec上，分别使用2、4、6个MoE块：四专家checkpoint获得源模型相对的五次平均NDCG@10比率99.92%-102.30%，A100加速比1.28x-1.63x；激进的二专家top-1配置获得98.36%-104.24%的性能比率和1.47x-2.21x的加速比。

Conclusion: 训练好的推荐MoE可以在多个服务预算下进行导出，且在性能几乎不损失甚至略有提升的情况下实现显著的推理加速，证明了功能相似性驱动的约束图粗化方法作为MoE后训练压缩的有效性。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. Across Amazon Beauty, KuaiRec, and TenRec with 2, 4, and 6 MoE blocks, the final four-expert checkpoints obtain source-relative five-run mean NDCG@10 ratios of 99.92%--102.30% and measured A100 speedups of 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$. An aggressive two-expert, top-1 operating point obtains ratios of 98.36%--104.24% and speedups of 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$. These endpoint results evaluate the complete conversion-and-adaptation workflow and show that a trained recommendation MoE can be exported at multiple serving budgets.

</details>


### [229] [A QUBO-Inspired Computational Framework for Airport Landside Bottleneck Diagnosis and Dynamic Dispatch Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08632)
*Wuming Lei,Xiaobin Li,Mingyan Sun,Jianing Long,Yulin Tong,Yanbin Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于QUBO思想的计算框架，用于机场陆侧交通枢纽（出租车上客区、网约车、私家车、巴士、地铁、停车设施及道路）的瓶颈诊断与动态调度。以上海浦东和杭州萧山机场为案例，建立五分钟状态模型，提出综合拥堵严重度指数进行瓶颈诊断，并比较有限动作模型预测控制与QUBO启发式模拟退火两种调度方案，结果显示QUBO方法在强高峰场景下显著降低排队长队，且在不同机场呈现不同主导瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机场陆侧交通中心在高峰时段面临旅客排队、车辆排队、上客泊位、停车区与道路的多重耦合拥堵，现有方法缺乏综合考虑多子系统交互的瓶颈诊断与动态调度框架，亟需一种可操作的计算方法来识别主导瓶颈并优化调度。

Method: 构建五分钟时间粒度的状态模型，耦合旅客到达、车辆供给、上客泊位服务、车辆存储与道路容量五个子系统。瓶颈诊断采用服务强度、道路需求饱和度、瓶颈频率、排队严重度、影子价格杠杆及综合拥堵严重度指数六个指标。调度方案包括有限动作模型预测控制（FA-MPC）和QUBO启发式模拟退火两种方法，在一致需求输入下进行对比测试。

Result: 在强高峰基线场景下，QUBO启发式方法将上海浦东的最终旅客排队从3445人降至2477人，杭州萧山从2053人降至1482人。案例显示不同机场主导瓶颈不同：上海浦东主要受道路饱和度制约，杭州萧山主要受上客泊位服务制约。在需求、供给、服务、道路容量、出行方式分担及随机噪声扰动下的鲁棒性测试中，排队削减收益保持稳定。

Conclusion: QUBO启发式调度框架在机场陆侧交通瓶颈诊断和排队缓解方面表现出显著有效性，且具备跨机场适用性与不确定性环境下的鲁棒性。研究同时揭示不同机场的瓶颈结构存在差异，为针对性运营优化提供了依据。

Abstract: Airport landside traffic centers connect terminal arrivals with taxis, ride-hailing vehicles, private cars, buses, metro services, parking facilities, and terminal-area roadways. Peak arrivals can create coupled congestion across passenger queues, vehicle queues, pickup berths, storage areas, and access roads. This study proposes a QUBO-inspired computational framework for bottleneck diagnosis and dynamic dispatch in this setting. Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport serve as case airports. A five-minute state model links passenger arrivals, vehicle supply, pickup berth service, vehicle storage, and road capacity. Bottleneck diagnosis uses service intensity, road demand saturation, bottleneck frequency, queue severity, shadow-price leverage, and a composite congestion severity index. Two dispatch schemes are tested under consistent demand inputs: finite-action model predictive control and quadratic-unconstrained-binary-optimization-inspired simulated annealing. In the strong-peak baseline scenario, the QUBO-inspired method reduces the final passenger queue from 3445 to 2477 passengers at Shanghai Pudong and from 2053 to 1482 passengers at Hangzhou Xiaoshan. Case results indicate different dominant bottlenecks. Shanghai Pudong is more affected by road saturation, whereas Hangzhou Xiaoshan is more affected by pickup berth service. Robustness tests under demand, supply, service, road-capacity, modal-share, and random-noise perturbations show retained queue-reduction benefits under the tested uncertainty levels.

</details>


### [230] [Can Open-Weight Models Compete on Financial Text Comprehension?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08634)
*Jan Spörer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文更新了Financial Touchstone基准测试，包含495份国际年报中的2,967个问答对，并将模型覆盖范围从11个扩展到20个（涵盖10家提供商），包括GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2等开源权重模型及Qwen3-Max专有模型。结果显示Claude Opus 4.6准确率最高（88.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%），而Kimi K2.6排名第三，非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3分列第四、第五，挑战了推理架构或专有权重的必要性假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管中国AI实验室的开源权重语言模型在基准测试上已追赶专有前沿模型，但其在真实世界金融任务上的可靠性尚未得到充分验证。作者旨在填补这一评估空白，系统性测试最新开源与专有模型在金融文档理解上的表现。

Method: 作者更新了Financial Touchstone基准，构建了覆盖495份国际年报的2,967个问答三元组，扩展模型集合从11个增至20个（覆盖10家提供商），涵盖最新的开源权重模型（如GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2）以及阿里巴巴专有旗舰模型Qwen3-Max，在统一框架下进行准确率和幻觉率评估。

Result: Anthropic的Claude Opus 4.6以88.4%准确率居首，Google的Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%）。开源权重模型Kimi K2.6准确率排名第三，非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3分列第四、第五。信息检索仍是主要瓶颈，占全部失败案例的48.9%。此外，中国模型中的地理政治内容过滤器会拒绝合法的金融问题（占0.08%），且拒绝行为受访问路径影响，新发现该行为不仅取决于模型本身。

Conclusion: 开源权重模型在金融理解任务中已具备与专有前沿模型竞争的实力，推理架构和专有权重并非金融理解能力的必要前提。研究同时揭示了信息检索瓶颈和地理政治内容过滤问题，提出了模型可靠性的新考量维度。完整数据集和评估框架已公开，供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Open-weight language models from Chinese AI labs caught up on benchmarks relative to proprietary frontier models in recent months. Yet their reliability on real-world financial tasks remains largely untested. We updated the Financial Touchstone benchmark, which now has 2,967 question context-answer triplets across 495 international annual reports. We also apply a new set of models on the benchmark, expanding coverage from eleven to twenty models across ten providers, including recent open-weight models such as GLM 4.7, GLM 5, Kimi K2.6, and DeepSeek V3.2, as well as Alibaba's proprietary flagship Qwen3-Max. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest accuracy (88.4%), while Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro maintains the lowest hallucination rate (0.08%). Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 ranks third in accuracy, and the non-reasoning models GLM 5 and Mistral 3 rank fourth and fifth, challenging the assumption that reasoning architectures or proprietary weights are a prerequisite for strong financial comprehension. Information retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, accounting for 48.9% of all failures. We also document a new finding: geopolitical content filters in Chinese models refuse legitimate financial questions (0.08% of attempts), sometimes without clear reason, and the refusal behavior depends on the access route as much as on the model. The complete dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available.

</details>


### [231] [Smart Compaction: Predicting Compaction Utility from Lakehouse Table Metadata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08639)
*Jannic Cutura,Subash Prakash*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个开放模拟框架，生成2,376个Apache Iceberg表，提取17个清单文件元数据特征，训练XGBoost模型预测文件缩减比（R²=0.998），但发现二值压缩决策本质上可被单一分区级阈值（max_files_per_partition>4）线性分离，无需学习模型。跨schema验证（TPC-H的96个表）确认了泛化能力（R²=0.976）。查询基准表明压缩对元数据密集型查询有利，但可能因降低任务并行度而拖慢全表扫描聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 湖仓表格式（如Iceberg）随时间的推移会积累大量小数据文件，导致查询性能下降。然而，何时触发压缩（compaction）仍是阈值驱动的，缺乏对哪些元数据特征真正决定压缩效用的深入理解。

Method: 构建开放模拟框架生成2,376个Apache Iceberg表（文件大小跨越三个数量级），从清单（manifest）文件中提取17个元数据特征（无需读取数据），训练XGBoost回归模型预测连续的文件缩减比（file-reduction ratio），并评估跨schema泛化性能及压缩对查询性能的影响。

Result: XGBoost模型在文件缩减比回归任务上达到R²=0.998、RMSE=0.013；但二值压缩决策仅需单一阈值max_files_per_partition>4即可完美分离，无需复杂模型。跨schema在96个TPC-H表上验证R²=0.976（无需重训）。查询基准显示压缩提升元数据密集型查询性能，但会因减少任务并行度而拖慢全表扫描聚合。

Conclusion: 压缩效用的关键元数据特征是可解释的，且高精度预测并不需要复杂学习模型——一个简单的分区级文件数阈值即可达到同等决策效果。此外，压缩并非无条件有益，需权衡元数据开销与任务并行度之间的取舍。

Abstract: Open lakehouse table formats accumulate small data files over time, which degrades query performance. Deciding when compaction is worthwhile remains threshold-driven, but which metadata features actually determine compaction utility is not well understood. We present an open simulation framework that generates 2,376 Apache Iceberg tables spanning three orders of magnitude in file size, extracts 17 metadata features from manifest files without reading data, and trains XGBoost to predict the continuous file-reduction ratio (R2 = 0.998, RMSE= 0.013). The binary compaction decision turns out to be trivially separable by a single partition-level threshold max_files_per_partition> 4, requiring no learned model. Cross-schema validation on 96 TPC-H tables confirms generalisation without retraining (R2 = 0.976). A query benchmark reveals that compaction benefits metadata-heavy queries but can slow full-scan aggregations by reducing task parallelism. All code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [232] [SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08640)
*Donghong Jiang,Endian Lin,Luoping Cui,Hanqing Liu,Mingjie Liu,Fan Yang,Hong Wang,Zhao Yang,Chuang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillReason-Bench基准（3,729个查询、61,228个技能、覆盖九个领域）以及SkillReason两阶段框架，通过链式思维推理作为训练时的监督信号来增强技能检索能力，在三个基准上均达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体依赖可复用技能库来扩展能力，但现实用户的请求往往简短且缺乏明确说明，只陈述任务目标而隐含所需能力和执行步骤，导致从大规模技能库中检索合适技能充满挑战。现有基准对此类请求的覆盖有限。

Method: SkillReason采用两阶段框架：Stage I利用更强教师模型生成能力推理轨迹，通过对比学习、检索分布对齐和语言建模三种监督信号进行训练，促使检索器将能力推理内化到查询表示中；Stage II采用检索引导的GRPO目标，鼓励模型探索更适合自身能力且对检索更有效的推理轨迹。推理时直接编码原始查询，无需自回归生成CoT，保持高效的纯查询检索。

Result: 在SkillReason-Bench、SkillRet和SRA-Bench三个基准上的大量实验表明，SkillReason均取得了最先进的性能，证明推理增强训练能更好地弥合高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义鸿沟。

Conclusion: 推理增强的训练方法能够有效缩小高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义差距，且通过将能力推理内化到查询表示中，可以在推理时避免额外的CoT生成开销，兼顾检索效果与效率。

Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowl- edge. However, retrieving the appropriate skill from a large- scale library remains challenging because realistic user re- quests are often concise and underspecified, stating only the task goal while leaving the required capabilities and execu- tion steps implicit. Existing benchmarks provide limited cov- erage of such requests. To address this gap, we introduce SkillReason-Bench, a large-scale cross-domain benchmark containing 3,729 queries and a retrieval corpus of 61,228 skills spanning nine domains. We further propose SkillRea- son, a two-stage framework that uses chain-of-thought rea- soning as training-time supervision for skill retrieval. In Stage I, capability reasoning traces generated by a stronger teacher provide explicit supervision through contrastive learning, re- trieval distribution alignment, and language modeling, en- couraging the retriever to internalize capability reasoning in its query representation. In Stage II, a retrieval-guided GRPO objective encourages the model to explore reasoning trajecto- ries better suited to its own capabilities and more effective for retrieval. At inference, SkillReason directly encodes the orig- inal query without autoregressive CoT generation, preserv- ing efficient query-only retrieval. Extensive experiments on SkillReason-Bench, SkillRet, and SRA-Bench show that Skill- Reason achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating that reasoning-enhanced training better bridges the semantic gap between high-level task goals and skill capabilities.

</details>


### [233] [The Scaffolding Matters More Than the Interface: A Controlled Comparison of MCP and CLI Tool Use Across Seven Agent Scaffoldings, Five Language Models, and One Software Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08654)
*Marc Alier Forment,María José Casañ Guerrero,Francisco José García-Peñalvo,Juanan Pereira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过控制单一软件任务（对私有在线git仓库执行六项操作），在七个agent脚手架和五个语言模型上系统测量了MCP与CLI两种工具接口的使用成本。结果发现主导成本因素是脚手架而非接口：不支持MCP的两个脚手架全程仅用CLI完成任务，且比支持MCP的五个脚手架便宜5.0倍至28倍。MCP与CLI的成本比在0.43x到29x间剧烈波动，两者在失败频率上无差异，但MCP在失败成本上更贵（12.9%的资金用于未完成的工作，CLI仅为2.2%）。数据、代码和验证方法已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于AI编码代理通过MCP与CLI使用工具的运行成本，已有的从业者报告估计存在超过一个数量级的分歧且无法复现。作者希望以可复现的实验方式系统测量两种接口的实际成本差异，并揭示真正的成本驱动因素。

Method: 选取一个固定软件任务（六次操作针对一个私有在线git仓库），在七个不同agent脚手架和五个语言模型上分别运行。通过检查仓库的实际状态（而非代理自报）来验证任务是否真正完成。所有脚手架、任务、验证代码及完整数据集均以开源方式发布。

Result: （1）脚手架是成本的主导因素：不支持MCP的两个脚手架仅用CLI完成任务，比支持MCP的五个脚手架便宜5.0-28倍；（2）对于本地运行的27B小模型，成本在不同脚手架间差异高达139倍；（3）严格的MCP对CLI配对成本比在0.43x到29x之间，两侧均有异常值，比较不稳定；（4）MCP与CLI的失败频率相当，但MCP的失败成本显著更高（12.9%的资金耗费在未完成工作上，CLI仅2.2%）；（5）代理经常忽略被分配的接口，导致未验证实际行为的对比衡量的是未知的混合情况。

Conclusion: 在AI编码代理的成本分析中，脚手架的选择比工具接口（MCP vs CLI）对成本的影响大得多。MCP并非此类工作的必要条件，且其在"失败所浪费的资金"这个维度上明显劣于CLI。由于代理可能不遵守接口分配，任何不验证实际行为的对比都是不可靠的。研究以开源形式提供了完整可复现的实验框架。

Abstract: How much an AI coding agent costs to run can depend more on the agent scaffolding that drives it than on the interface through which it
  reaches its tools. We set out to measure the cost of tool use over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) against tool use over an ordinary
  command-line interface (CLI), a difference on which published estimates disagree by more than an order of magnitude while resting on
  practitioner reports that cannot be reproduced. We ran one fixed software task -- six operations against a private online git repository --
  across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, and we verified completion by inspecting the repository state rather than trusting
  the agent's self-report. The dominant effect was the scaffolding. Two of the seven ship no MCP support at all; they completed every run using
  only the CLI, which shows that MCP is unnecessary for this class of work, and they were 5.0x to 28x cheaper than the five scaffoldings that
  do support MCP, comparing CLI runs alone with no MCP server attached anywhere. The effect was largest for a small 27-billion-parameter model
  running locally, whose cost varied 139x across scaffoldings while it completed the task under all of them. The comparison we set out to make
  proved unstable: thirteen strictly paired MCP-to-CLI ratios span 0.43x to 29x, with outliers on both sides. The two interfaces separate on
  the cost of failure, where 12.9 per cent of the money spent on MCP runs bought no completed work against 2.2 per cent on CLI runs, but not on
  its frequency: failures were equally common in both, in the original runs and in their repetitions alike. Agents frequently ignored the
  interface they were assigned, so comparisons that do not verify actual behaviour measure an unknown mixture. The harness, the task, the
  verification and the complete dataset are released as open source.

</details>


### [234] [Branch2Skill: Efficient Skill Evolution Through Reasoning Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08677)
*Yanwei Ren,Haotian Zhang,Likang Xiao,Jiaxing Huang,Jiayan Qiu,Baosheng Yu,Quan Chen,Liu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Branch2Skill是一个高效的技能演化框架，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索在固定预算下生成多样化推理轨迹，并利用精英路径与共享前缀的兄弟路径对比，提取分步证据用于技能更新，从而将单一推理树转化为密集监督，显著减少重复的rollout-update循环和token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能演化方法主要依赖单条轨迹进行反馈，早期推理错误会沿后续步骤传播，削弱用于技能优化的反馈质量。这导致技能提升需要反复经历rollout、诊断和更新的循环，产生高昂的token成本。因此需要一种更高效的机制，从单次推理过程中提取更密集、更细粒度的监督信号。

Method: Branch2Skill包含三个核心步骤：(1) 在固定预算下对每个任务执行蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），生成多条多样化的推理轨迹；(2) 将精英路径（最优轨迹）与共享相同前缀的兄弟替代路径进行对比，提取分步证据，识别哪些推理模式应当保留、修改或避免；(3) 将多步证据蒸馏为可复用的技能更新，使单一推理树同时为多个推理步骤提供监督，减少重复的rollout-update循环。

Result: 在六个涵盖推理和智能体任务的基准上，Branch2Skill一致地提升了任务性能并提高了技能演化效率。具体而言，以GPT 5.5作为目标模型时，Branch2Skill相比SkillOpt节省了73.2%的token消耗，同时取得了更优的性能。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明推理树不仅能支持更有效的轨迹搜索，还能提供更丰富的监督信号用于更高效的技能改进，为技能演化提供了一种低成本、高密度的监督范式。

Abstract: Skill evolution improves agent skills through feedback over time, with failed trajectories often providing informative signals by revealing incomplete or misleading behaviors. However, existing methods mainly rely on single trajectories, where early reasoning errors can propagate through subsequent steps and weaken the feedback available for skill refinement. Consequently, improving skills requires repeated cycles of rollout, diagnosis, and update, incurring substantial token costs. To address this challenge, we introduce Branch2Skill, an efficient framework that transforms a single reasoning tree into dense supervision for skill evolution. For each task or problem, Branch2Skill performs Monte Carlo tree search under a fixed budget to obtain diverse reasoning trajectories, then compares an elite path with sibling alternatives sharing the same prefixes to extract step-wise evidence about which reasoning patterns to retain, revise, or avoid. Finally, Branch2Skill distills multi-step evidence into reusable updates, allowing one reasoning tree to provide supervision across multiple reasoning steps and reducing the need for repeated rollout-update cycles. Across six benchmarks covering reasoning and agentic tasks, Branch2Skill consistently improves task performance while enhancing skill evolution efficiency. For example, with GPT 5.5 as the target model, Branch2Skill uses 73.2% fewer tokens than SkillOpt, while achieving superior performance. These results demonstrate that reasoning trees can support not only more effective trajectory search, but also richer supervision for more efficient skill improvement. Code will be published.

</details>


### [235] [A Structural Dynamics Graph World Model: Unified Modeling, Constrained Rollout, and Interpretable Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08689)
*Wei Wang,Yaosen Chen,Han Yang,Yuegen Liu,Mingli Luo,Xinxin Jiao,Xuming Wen,Ming Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SD-GWM（结构动力学图世界模型），将复杂系统状态演化分解为自动力学S、邻居图耦合动力学N、有界残差R和全局约束投影四部分，作为可执行的结构化契约，实现异构机制融合、语义保真与可审计治理，在极端洪水场景下显著优于持久性和神经网络基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有复杂系统建模面临两难：将所有机制放入单一黑箱导致机制归因和约束保持不可审计；而将每个机制强行纳入统一方程族则抛弃了成熟的领域求解器。需要一个既能融合异构机制（规则、ODE、求解器），又能保证语义保真、约束可行性和可审计性的结构化建模框架。

Method: SD-GWM将状态演化显式分解为四个组成部分：节点自动力学S、边上的邻居图耦合动力学N（两者为固定形式的机制资产，仅校准授权参数）、可选的有界残差R（集中可学习性）、全局投影映射到可行域（强制约束）。预先注册八个研究问题，并支持逐步追踪的对抗性故障定位。

Result: 在八个预注册研究问题上：(i)异构集成——规则和求解器可原生接入；(ii)语义保真——禁用R后位级保持源语义，四个理论性质有明确的证明/实证边界；(iii)可审计治理——逐步追踪实现对抗性故障定位（top-1=1.0）。在洪水测试台和USGS流量数据上，约束违反降至浮点容差/零。254天极端洪水期间基线RMSE为892-3007 cfs而SD-GWM保持108 cfs（8-28倍增益）；有界残差仅在骨干偏差下约降RMSE 50%。

Conclusion: SD-GWM并非追求普遍优于所有预测器的通用模型，而是定位为可验证的基座，用于可审计、约束安全的时空数据挖掘，在机制归因透明度与学习灵活性之间提供了结构性折中。

Abstract: The state evolution of a complex system arises jointly from object laws, relational propagation, domain conservation, and unmodeled error. Forcing all sources into one black box makes mechanism attribution and constraint preservation unauditable; forcing every mechanism into one equation family discards mature domain solvers. We propose SD-GWM, a Structural Dynamics Graph World Model as an executable structural contract: nodes declare self-dynamics S, edges declare neighbor graph-coupled dynamics N---both fixed-form mechanism assets (rules, ODEs, solvers) calibrating only authorized parameters. An optional bounded residual R concentrates learnability, while a global projection maps states to feasibility, enforcing constraints without guaranteeing accuracy gains. On eight pre-registered research questions, SD-GWM delivers (i) heterogeneous integration: rules and solvers plug in natively; (ii) semantic fidelity: disabling R preserves source semantics bit-for-bit, with four theory properties under explicit proof/empirical boundaries; (iii) auditable governance: stepwise traces enable counterfactual fault localization (top-1 = 1.0) without post-hoc approximations. On a semi-synthetic flood testbed and USGS streamflow, SD-GWM reduces constraint violations to floating-point tolerance in analytical tests and to zero in semi-synthetic and real-data cases. Persistence matches SD-GWM in calm periods, but during a 254-day extreme-flood shift persistence and all neural baselines collapse (90-min RMSE 892-3007 cfs) while SD-GWM holds at 108 cfs (8-28x gain). The bounded residual cuts RMSE ~50% only under backbone bias. We position SD-GWM not as a universally superior forecaster, but as a verifiable substrate for auditable, constraint-safe spatiotemporal mining.

</details>


### [236] [Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08822)
*Abdalla Doleh,Toni Somers,Ratna Babu Chinnam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化流水线，利用LLM生成结构化的认知决策场景，并通过基于任务复杂性理论的复合框架验证其复杂性。在4,238个场景上的评估表明，该系统的心理测量学性质良好（ICC=0.997，kappa=0.971），能够可靠地将场景分类为简单、中等和复杂三个层级，为AI系统的下游认知评估提供测量基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知决策研究需要多样性且复杂度可控的场景，但手动生成场景缓慢、不一致且存在偏差，缺乏自动化且可靠的方式来批量生成具有可验证复杂性的决策场景。

Method: 构建了一个自动化流水线：(1) 使用LLM生成结构化的决策场景；(2) 通过基于既有任务复杂性理论的复合框架验证场景复杂度；(3) 评估4,238个场景，涵盖多个领域和复杂度层级；使用ICC、kappa、eta-squared、因子分析、偏相关等统计方法进行心理测量学验证。

Result: 心理测量学验证达到严格标准：五个独立模型间的ICC为0.997，kappa为0.971；已知组效度显示层级间分离显著（eta-squared=0.587，所有配对比较p<.001）；因子分析显示主导性复杂度构念（载荷0.87-0.96），互动性为较弱次要维度（0.34）。判别效度受限于复杂度与文本长度的强相关（偏相关r=0.86）。模型比较显示吞吐量与模式通过率负相关（r=-0.967），Llama 4 Maverick生成最快（134个/分钟）但复杂层级生成不足，DeepSeek Chat V3.2在领域覆盖和模式合规性上更均衡。

Conclusion: 该系统展现出强大的心理测量学性质，能够可靠地将场景分类为简单、中等和复杂三个层级，为AI系统的下游认知评估提供了所需的测量基础设施。尽管复杂度与文本长度的强关联在一定程度上限制了构念纯度，但不影响其作为层级分级工具的功能。

Abstract: Cognitive decision-making research depends on diverse scenarios with carefully controlled complexity, yet manual production is slow, inconsistent, and biased. We developed an automated pipeline that uses LLms to generate structured decision scenarios and validates their complexity through a composite framework rooted in established task-complexity theory. We evaluated 4,238 scenarios across multiple domains and complexity tiers. Measurement validation met rigorous psychometric standards. Agreement among five independent model families was nearly perfect, with an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.997 and a kappa of 0.971. Known-groups validity demonstrated large separation between tiers, with an eta-squared of 0.587 and all pairwise comparisons significant at p less than .001. Factor analysis revealed a dominant complexity construct, with loadings between 0.87 and 0.96 across three frameworks, while interactivity formed a weaker secondary dimension at 0.34. Discriminant validity was limited by a strong relationship between complexity and text length that persisted after controlling for tier, yielding a partial correlation of 0.86. This constrains construct purity but does not undermine the instrument's tier-grading function. Model analyses showed a negative association between throughput and schema pass rate (r = -0.967, p = .007, n = 5), suggesting a speed-quality trade-off, though largely driven by one high-throughput model. Llama 4 Maverick generated scenarios fastest at 134 per minute versus 25 for DeepSeek Chat V3.2, but underproduced complex-tier scenarios, whereas DeepSeek Chat V3.2 balanced domain coverage with high schema compliance. The system demonstrated strong psychometric properties, enabling reliable classification into Simple, Moderate, and Complex tiers and providing the measurement infrastructure needed for downstream cognitive assessment of AI systems

</details>


### [237] [EnergyBridge: Benchmarking Household Energy Management, User Participation, and Grid Flexibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08691)
*Xudong Wu,Zeqing Wu,Jiarui Zhang,Xuhao Fan,Ziang Ding,Yuming Zhuang,Mingqi Yuan,Yilun Du,Hongjie Jia,Yunfei Mu,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnergyBridge是一个将容量报告、家庭用户授权与实际执行结合的住宅虚拟电厂基准测试和智能体框架，通过LLM驱动的用户参与模拟器在天津和柏林的EnergyPlus环境中评估控制器与智能体的物理灵活性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有住宅VPP基准仅评估物理控制性能，忽略了用户授权这一关键环节——物理灵活性只有在居民同意计划并实际履行承诺时才成为可靠容量。已有基准缺少事件级别的授权建模，导致评估结果无法反映真实的可调度能力。

Method: 提出EnergyBridge框架，包含三个方面：(1) 天津和柏林两个地区特定的EnergyPlus环境；(2) LLM驱动的用户参与模拟器(User Participation Simulator)；(3) 连接容量报告、家庭授权与物理执行的整体评估流程。采用584个按人物画像和事件匹配的人类角色扮演判断进行校准验证。

Result: LLM用户参与模拟器在584个人类角色扮演判断上保持方法排序一致性，平均绝对接受误差为5.3点。在常规控制器和智能体基线的对比中，EnergyBridge在两个地区均取得最高模拟授权率、最低事件窗口能耗以及最可靠的容量承诺。

Conclusion: EnergyBridge验证了将用户授权纳入VPP基准评估的可行性与必要性，为以人为中心的电网灵活性研究提供了可复现的数据、代码和评估基准。数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Residential virtual power plants (VPPs) can provide grid flexibility by shifting household demand, but physical flexibility becomes dependable capacity only when residents authorize a plan and the promised response is delivered. Existing benchmarks evaluate control but omit event-specific authorization. We present EnergyBridge, a benchmark and agent framework connecting capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution. It combines region-specific EnergyPlus environments for Tianjin and Berlin with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator. Against 584 persona- and event-matched human role-play judgments, the LLM-based User Participation Simulator preserves method ordering with a 5.3-point mean absolute acceptance error. Across conventional controllers and agent baselines, EnergyBridge achieves the highest simulated authorization, lowest event-window energy, and the most reliable capacity commitment in both regions. We release human data and codes for reproducible human-centered grid-flexibility research: https://github.com/Agentic-Intelligence-Lab/EnergyBridge.

</details>


### [238] [Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08881)
*David M. Markowitz,Timothy R. Levine*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究基于七种领先的欺骗理论开发了七种检索增强生成（RAG）模型，并在5个公开数据集、700条陈述、4种大语言模型（gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash）及两种运行模式（RAG vs. 基线）下进行了39,200次欺骗判断。结果显示RAG模型（54.5%）与基线模型（54.6%）的检测准确率无显著差异，RAG模型略低于真话偏误（57.0% vs. 59.7%）但效应量极小。理论选择对准确率影响甚微，但对响应偏误影响显著（从可验证性方法的32.2%偏向欺骗到真话默认理论的88.1%偏向真话）。当前参数下理论引导的AI判断不可靠，但结合更多数据集、模型测试和理论与数据匹配或具潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索理论引导的检索增强生成（RAG）模型在欺骗检测任务中的表现，验证基于欺骗理论构建的AI系统是否能提升欺骗判断的准确性和校准偏差，填补理论引导AI在欺骗检测领域的实证空白。

Method: 以七种领先欺骗理论为基础构建七个RAG模型，在5个公开数据集上收集700条陈述，使用4种大语言模型（gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash），通过RAG与基线两种运行模式进行比较，共生成39,200次欺骗判断，分析准确率、真话偏误、内容效应及模型效应。

Result: RAG模型与基线模型的检测准确率无显著差异（54.5% vs. 54.6%），均与人类典型准确率一致。RAG模型真话偏误（57.0%）略低于基线（59.7%）但效应量小。理论选择对准确率影响很小，但对响应偏误影响巨大（可验证性方法32.2%偏向欺骗，真话默认理论88.1%偏向真话）。此外，内容效应和模型效应进一步调节了结果。

Conclusion: 当前参数下，理论引导的AI欺骗判断可靠性不足，但通过扩充数据集、测试更多模型以及优化理论与数据的匹配，可能展现出应用前景。研究强调了理论选择对响应偏误（而非准确率）的显著影响，提示未来需更精细地处理理论与任务间的关系。

Abstract: The current work developed seven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models based on leading deception theories and compared how deception judgments were made relative to baseline models. Across 700 statements drawn from five published deception datasets, four large language models (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash), and two run-types (RAG vs. baseline), a total of 39,200 deception judgments were rendered. Detection accuracies were consistent with typical human accuracies and not statistically different across RAG (54.5%) and baseline models (54.6%). RAG-based models (57.0%) were less truth-biased than baseline models (59.7%), but the effect size was quite small. Theoretical perspective mattered little for accuracy yet mattered substantially for response bias, which ranged from highly lie-biased (the verifiability approach, 32.2%) to highly truth-biased (truth-default theory, 88.1%). Content effects and model effects further moderated the results. Theory-guided AI judgments are unreliable with current parameters, yet they might show promise with additional datasets, model testing, and theory-to-data matching.

</details>


### [239] [PluginEval: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained Error Attribution in Function Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08700)
*Dongjie Xu,Julius,Hanchi Dong,Minghua Tang,Yuxuan Sun,Ziwei Nie,Zicheng Liu,Dujun Qing,Jiajie Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PluginEval，一个通过两阶段闭环框架构建的工具路由基准，旨在解决现有基准在数据分布偏差、缺少对抗性难负样本和LLM标注未经执行验证三方面的结构性局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具路由基准存在三个结构性缺陷：1) 数据遵循幂律分布导致稀有场景代表性不足；2) 缺乏对抗性难负样本使得不同模型间的性能差异不清晰；3) 依赖未经真实API执行验证的LLM判断进行标注，可靠性存疑。

Method: PluginEval采用两阶段框架：(1) 将工具路由形式化为三个决策序列，分离生成与验证——LLM提出候选调用，确定性验证与真实API执行提供可靠质量信号；(2) 按能力、意图和边界三个维度分解每个插件，识别触发与排除场景，生成不同难度级别的查询（包括针对三种失败模式的对抗性负样本）以填补覆盖缺口，并回传至第一阶段标注，形成闭环迭代直至覆盖收敛。评估时，基于gold标注锚定的LLM评审员将失败分类为漏调用、虚假调用或参数错误，生成细粒度错误画像。

Result: 对五个模型家族（包括专有模型和开放权重模型）进行了评估，分析了它们在不同难度级别和错误类别上的表现，并通过与人工标注的一致性验证了评审员的有效性。

Conclusion: PluginEval通过两阶段闭环的benchmark构建方法，系统性地缓解了现有工具路由评估的三大结构性局限，提供了一种更可靠、更细粒度的模型工具路由能力评估方案。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of tool routing is critical as Large Language Models increasingly operate as autonomous agents. Current benchmarks face three structural limitations: data distributions that follow a power law leave rare scenarios underrepresented; the absence of adversarial hard negatives obscures performance differences across models; and annotation pipelines depend on LLM judgments that have not been validated through execution. In this paper, we introduce PluginEval, a benchmark constructed through a two-stage framework that systematically mitigates these limitations. First, we formulate tool routing as a sequence of three decisions and separate generation from verification. LLMs propose candidate calls, while deterministic validation and real API execution provide reliable quality signals. Second, we decompose each plugin by capability, intent, and boundary to identify trigger and exclusion scenarios. We then generate queries at different difficulty levels to fill coverage gaps, including adversarial negatives targeting three failure modes, and return them to the first stage for annotation. This process creates a closed loop that iterates until coverage converges. For evaluation, we move beyond aggregate accuracy. An LLM judge anchored to gold annotations classifies failures as missed calls, spurious calls, or parameter errors, producing a detailed error profile for each model. We evaluate five model families, including proprietary models and models with open weights, analyze their performance across difficulty levels and error categories, and validate the judge through agreement with human annotations.

</details>


### [240] [PolicyKG: An Agentic LLM Pipeline for Translating Institutional Policies into SHACL Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09028)
*Ponkrit Kaewsawee,Chaklam Silpasuwanchai,Chutiporn Anutariya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PolicyKG 是一个LLM流水线系统，用于将机构政策PDF自动转换为机器可读的SHACL约束。它通过四阶段LangGraph状态机完成句子级模态分类（义务/许可/禁止）、一阶道义逻辑提升和SHACL生成。核心创新是语料适配器（Corpus Adapter）——一个YAML词汇表注册表，将LLM谓词锚定到目标本体，实现跨领域零训练迁移。在AIT政策语料上达到86.9%分类准确率和F1=0.866的SHACL形状正确性，并通过审计证明高阶逻辑构造在语料中占比极低（上限0.67%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机构政策以自然语言撰写，而合规检查系统需要机器可读约束。目前从自然语言政策到形式化约束的转换完全依赖人工，效率低下且容易出错。现有方法缺乏一个可扩展、可跨领域迁移的自动化桥梁。

Method: PolicyKG采用四阶段LangGraph状态机架构：(1) 对政策PDF句子进行deontic分类（义务/许可/禁止）；(2) 将标签提升为一阶道义逻辑（FOL）表示；(3) 生成SHACL约束，含直接NL-to-SHACL回退路径。核心组件是Corpus Adapter：一个YAML词汇表注册表，将LLM产生的谓词映射到目标本体，跨领域只需替换注册表无需重训练。每阶段配有验证器（validators）。

Result: 在AIT政策和程序语料（1,663句，443条规则）上：deontic分类准确率86.9%（Cohen's kappa=0.709），三位独立标注者一致性Fleiss' kappa=0.844；69个SHACL形状子集F1=0.866；79.2%的规则走FOL路径，其余走NL-to-SHACL回退。审计确认高阶逻辑构造率为0（上界0.67%）。将AIT注册表替换为GDPR注册表后，属性对齐从1/15提升到11/15（p<0.001）。在下游LexDeMod租赁合同基准上Macro F1降至0.370，归因于词汇匹配问题。输出具有确定性（hash相同）。

Conclusion: PolicyKG证明LLM流水线结合词汇注册表设计可以有效实现政策到机器约束的自动化转换。Corpus Adapter的模块化设计使跨领域迁移成为可能，但词汇表错配仍会显著影响性能，说明注册表质量是系统性能的关键瓶颈。高阶逻辑审计结果表明FOL表达力对该类政策语料是足够的，但需谨慎推广该结论。

Abstract: Institutional policies stay in natural language while the systems that check compliance demand machine-readable constraints. Bridging that gap is still done by hand.
  PolicyKG closes the loop. It is an LLM pipeline that reads a policy PDF, classifies each sentence as an obligation, permission, or prohibition, lifts the label into first-order deontic logic, and emits SHACL constraints. Four stages run on a LangGraph state machine with per-stage validators. The piece that matters most is the Corpus Adapter: a YAML vocabulary registry that grounds LLM predicates in a target ontology. Retargeting to a new domain means swapping the registry, not retraining a model.
  On the Asian Institute of Technology Policies and Procedures corpus (1,663 sentences, 443 rules), PolicyKG reaches 86.9% deontic classification accuracy (Cohen's kappa = .709). Three annotators independently re-label a 50-item sample and agree at Fleiss' kappa = .844. SHACL shape correctness on a 69-shape subset is F1 = .866. The FOL path handles 79.2% of rules; the rest go through a direct NL-to-SHACL fallback.
  We audited every one of the 443 rules for second- or higher-order constructs. An automated regex checklist flagged none, and a first-author pass on the 92 FOL-fallback cases confirmed the same. The exact upper 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the true HOL rate is 0.67%. This is an audit finding for one corpus, not a proof of FOL sufficiency for institutional policy.
  Swapping the AIT registry for a GDPR registry raises exact property alignment from 1/15 to 11/15 (Fisher's exact p < .001; Cohen's h = 1.53). On the LexDeMod lease-contract benchmark (N = 200), Macro F1 drops to .370 because lease English uses "shall be entitled" for permission -- exactly the vocabulary mismatch registry swap is meant to fix. Repeated runs produce hash-identical SHACL outputs.

</details>


### [241] [AI Evaluation Should Measure Verification Cost, Not Correctness Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08709)
*Viviana Crescitelli,Generoso Immediato,Fabio Persia,Stefania Costantini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"验证成本错误"（VCEs）概念，指在给定部署预算内，声明的验证者群体无法识别的错误输入-输出对。作者主张仅靠输出正确性不足以衡量AI生成模型的可靠性，评估应明确纳入验证成本这一操作性维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成模型的可靠性评估仅关注输出正确性，忽略了实际应用中用户需要耗费多少努力去验证输出的真实性。当前评估指标遗漏了一个关键失效模式：即使模型输出在基准测试中准确率高，在实际部署中用户可能因验证成本和资源限制而无法识别错误。

Method: 提出"验证成本错误"（VCE）的操作性定义——在给定验证预算内，声明比例的验证者群体无法识别的错误输入-输出对。引入"相对于部署预算的验证成本"作为操作性维度，并作为概念性工具而非最终化指标提出，同时通过代码生成和多模态文档理解任务进行论证。

Result: 代码生成和多模态文档理解任务的证据表明，高基准准确率可能掩盖实际中的显著验证工作量。错误的存在不能仅由输出本身的性质判定（如幻觉），而需考虑在资源约束下是否能被检测到。

Conclusion: 正确性不足以作为可靠性的度量标准。AI评估应明确纳入验证成本，反映错误是否能在现实资源约束下被检测，而合理性（plausibility）和权威性呈现只是促成验证失败的假设因素而非定义条件。

Abstract: The reliability of AI generative models is typically measured by output correctness, yet in practice it depends on the effort required to verify those outputs. We argue that current evaluation metrics overlook a critical failure mode: Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs), defined as incorrect input-output pairs that a declared fraction of the verifier population fails to identify within the verification budget available in a given deployment context. Unlike standard notions of "hallucination", VCEs are defined operationally, by the failure of correct identification within budget rather than by any property of the output itself. Plausibility and authoritative presentation are hypothesised contributors to that failure, not defining conditions. To capture this asymmetry, we introduce the notion of verification cost relative to a deployment budget as an operational dimension that current evaluation does not routinely capture. The quantity is presented as a conceptual instrument rather than a finalized metric. Evidence from code generation and multi-modal document understanding shows that high benchmark accuracy can mask significant verification effort in practice. We therefore take the position that correctness alone is insufficient as a measure of reliability. AI evaluation should explicitly account for verification cost, reflecting whether errors can be detected under realistic resource constraints.

</details>


### [242] [Business Truth, not SQL Accuracy: A Rule-Gated 7B Analytics Agent Outperforms a Direct-Prompted 32B Baseline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09254)
*Morris Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出WarehouseReliabilityBench，一个包含400个冻结任务、跨两个合成仓库的基准，其中约半数正确答案是澄清、弃权或拒绝。作者引入QueryProof，一个7B参数的分析智能体，基于语义层和物理目录规则并结合确定性执行后检查来工作。在80任务测试集上，QueryProof比直接提示的32B基线在业务真值率上高出+0.237，同时成本降低71%，但缺少组件级消融。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM分析智能体评估仅关注SQL语法正确性，但生产环境中的实际失败模式不同：存在双重业务定义、仓库无法回答的问题、schema变更后的弃用列、以及执行成功但返回错误业务数字的查询。没有任何执行匹配指标能对这些失败评分，因此需要一个新的基准和评估方法。

Method: 构建含400个冻结任务的基准（两个合成仓库），其中约一半正确回答是澄清、弃权或拒绝。提出QueryProof——一个7B参数智能体，使用从语义层和物理目录推导的规则来决定行为，并以确定性执行后检查门控每个答案。采用预注册配对bootstrap方法，在数字存在前固定每个声明动词来保障统计严谨性。

Result: QueryProof在80任务测试集上比直接提示的32B基线高出+0.237业务真值率，且每个正确答案成本降低71.0%；与成本匹配的少样本基线相比准确性优势保持但成本差异不显著。错误成功从0.754降至0.351，可回答任务上无误数字返回（0/24）。但移除路由层变化很小（0.562对0.537），路由调优在测试集上过度弃权，拟合置信模型不如所替代的启发式，按模板族重采样时置信区间包含零。

Conclusion: QueryProof在仓库可靠性任务上优于大参数基线，效果方向得到支持但幅度不确定，主要增益来自确定性层而非路由层。该基准填补了现有SQL语法匹配评估在生产失败模式上的空白，但未来需组件级消融以明确各部分的贡献。

Abstract: LLM analytics agents are evaluated on SQL syntax accuracy, but production failures look different: questions with two valid business definitions, questions the warehouse cannot answer, deprecated columns after a schema change, and queries that execute successfully while returning the wrong business number. No execution-match metric can score them. This paper introduces WarehouseReliabilityBench, 400 frozen tasks over two synthetic warehouses in which roughly half the correct responses are a clarification, an abstention or a refusal, with pinned denominators and a pre-registered paired bootstrap fixing each claim verb before the numbers existed. QueryProof, a 7B agent, uses rules derived from a semantic layer and physical catalog to determine its behaviour, and gates every answer on deterministic post-execution checks. On an 80-task synthetic test split evaluated once, QueryProof outperforms a direct-prompted 32B baseline by +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] Business Truth Rate at 71.0% lower cost per correct answer; against a cost-matched few-shot baseline the accuracy gain holds but the cost difference does not resolve. This compares systems rather than model sizes: the 32B baseline receives none of the scaffolding. False success falls from 0.754 to 0.351 of returned answers, and no wrong number was returned on an answerable task (0 of 24), though 13 answers went to questions requiring clarification or abstention. Removing the routing layer changes little (0.562 against 0.537), so the result does not depend on escalation. Routing tuned on validation over-abstains on test, and the fitted confidence model loses to the heuristic it replaced. Resampling template families rather than tasks widens both accuracy intervals to include zero, so the effect's direction is better supported than its magnitude. The gain tracks the deterministic layer, though no component ablation was run.

</details>


### [243] [FitAQA: A Benchmark of Fitness Action Quality Assessment for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08736)
*Kaili Zheng,Kaiwen Wang,Xun Zhu,Qingyuan Yang,Chenyi Guo,Ji Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FitAQA，一个面向健身动作质量评估（AQA）的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）系统评测基准，包含2,219个视频和5,512个QA实例，覆盖30种自重训练动作，并设计了统一的错误分类法和三个评估任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动作质量评估基准依赖于特定动作的标注方案，且主要关注最终评估输出，无法深入理解MLLM如何评估动作质量。因此需要一个系统性基准来揭露MLLM在健身AQA场景中的能力短板。

Method: 与运动科学专家合作构建统一的动作错误分类法，定义38种常见动作错误，归入六个互补质量维度（对齐、对称、稳定性、协调、节奏、完整性）；设计三个评估任务：感知（识别视觉证据）、判断（结合领域知识评估执行正确性）、时间定位（定位错误发生的时间段）。

Result: 实验表明当前MLLM在全面评估动作质量和精确定位动作错误方面仍有困难；控制实验进一步显示视觉感知是关键瓶颈，当提供真实感知证据时，判断任务的表现显著提升。

Conclusion: FitAQA揭示了MLLM在健身动作质量评估中的不足，指出视觉感知是主要瓶颈，为后续研究和模型改进提供了方向；数据及评测代码将公开。

Abstract: Fitness Action Quality Assessment (AQA) is important for intelligent sports training, yet the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in this setting remain underexplored. Existing benchmarks rely on action-specific annotation schemes and focus primarily on final assessment outputs, offering limited insight into how models assess exercise quality. We introduce FitAQA, a systematic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in fitness AQA, containing 2,219 videos and 5,512 QA instances across 30 bodyweight exercises. In collaboration with experts in sports science, we develop a unified form error taxonomy that defines 38 recurring form errors within six complementary quality dimensions: alignment, symmetry, stability, coordination, tempo, and completeness. This taxonomy provides a shared assessment framework across different exercises. FitAQA further formulates three evaluation tasks: perception for recognizing relevant visual evidence, judgement for combining that evidence with domain knowledge to assess execution correctness, and temporal grounding for localizing form errors over time. Extensive evaluation shows that current MLLMs still struggle to assess exercise quality comprehensively and localize form errors precisely. Controlled experiments further indicate that visual perception is a key bottleneck, as judgement performance improves substantially when ground-truth perceptual evidence is provided. The dataset and evaluation code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [244] [ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09282)
*Adrian Li,Kelong Mao,Yudong Guo,Heming Xia,Xinwei Yang,Lirui Luo,Jace Wong,Pu Yao,Sulong Xu,Simiu Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ComboShoppingBench，一个面向开放但可验证的组合购物任务的智能体购物基准测试，结合LLM语义评判与确定性验证，在模拟电商及外卖环境中评估智能体组合购物能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实购物场景常常需要构建互补商品的购物篮（如设备配置、备餐、活动规划、团体外卖），而非检索单一产品。此类任务要求联合推理商品兼容性、可用性、店铺门槛、配送费、优惠券和预算。评估困难在于：多个篮子可能满足同一需求，精确匹配指标不适用；而纯语义评估无法检测不可行的订单、无效优惠券组合或错误支付。因此需要既能处理开放性任务又能够验证可行性的基准。

Method: 引入ComboShoppingBench，在模拟商业和外卖环境中进行开放但可验证的篮子构建。任务合成阶段：探索智能体构建可行且语义连贯的可购商品篮子，作为witness引导优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和对齐评估标准的生成。评估阶段采用双重机制：LLM评判器评估语义满意度、响应质量和声明忠实度；确定性验证检查产品ID有效性、预算符合性和优惠券最优性。

Result: 对多种LLM智能体的实验表明，即使是强智能体在ComboShoppingBench上也表现挣扎，凸显了在可靠、约束感知的组合购物方面仍有很大的改进空间。

Conclusion: ComboShoppingBench揭示了现有LLM智能体在组合购物任务上的显著不足，说明可靠且约束感知的组合购物仍是未被充分解决的关键挑战。

Abstract: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic evaluation alone cannot detect infeasible orders, invalid coupon combinations, or incorrect payments. We introduce ComboShoppingBench, an agentic shopping benchmark for open-ended yet verifiable basket construction in a simulated commerce and takeout environment. During task synthesis, an exploration agent constructs a feasible and semantically coherent basket of purchasable products; this witness guides the generation of coupons, budget constraints, user queries, and aligned evaluation rubrics. During evaluation, LLM judges assess semantic satisfaction, response quality, and claim faithfulness, while deterministic validation checks product-ID validity, budget compliance, and coupon optimality. Experiments with diverse LLM agents demonstrate that even strong agents struggle on ComboShoppingBench, highlighting substantial room for improvement in reliable, constraint-aware combo shopping.

</details>


### [245] [Scale-to-Dialogue: Low-Burden Elicitation of Daily Premenstrual Symptom Ratings with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08746)
*Yifan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究将经前每日症状追踪的会话式问卷构建为序数标签恢复问题，使用ModernBERT进行症状表达检测、Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct生成结构化严重度评分。在mcPHASES数据集的2,160个症状标签上，固定三症状簇联合提问达到0.913的二次加权kappa，减少50%问题量，同时保持97.45%的严重度级别内一致率和80.94%的中度及以上症状召回率，证明了从自然会话到可复用每日症状标签的可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经前健康评估依赖每日症状的序数追踪，但重复的序数表格形式给用户带来显著的应答负担，需要探索更自然的会话式收集方案。

Method: 将会话式问卷形式化为序数标签恢复问题：系统主动询问少量症状簇并映射回原始严重度标签。采用双模型架构——ModernBERT作为证据门检测症状是否被表达，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct生成确定性的结构化严重度评分。实验对比了固定六项提问、三症状簇联合提问及开放优先自适应策略。

Result: 固定六项提问达到0.976的二次加权kappa；三症状簇联合提问达到0.913的kappa、97.45%严重度级别内一致率、80.94%中度及以上症状召回率，同时减少50%问题量。开放优先自适应策略需3.92-5.98个问题但一致性更低。参与簇自举分析估计三簇与六项策略的kappa差异为-0.062（95% CI -0.076至-0.048）。

Conclusion: 主动的簇级症状询问提供了一种直接、基于局部模型的路径，可从自然对话中恢复可复用的日常症状严重度标签，在显著降低应答负担的同时保持较高的测量一致性。
